Indicate the confidence level in the hypothesis (high/medium/low). Group the outcomes into 3–5 business objectives. If no metrics are defined, infer reasonable proxies and declare it. Deliver a markdown table with columns Objective, Outcome, Enabling Output, Hypothesis, and Confidence. If more than 50% of hypotheses are low confidence, add a discovery recommendation.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Identify outcomes → write hypotheses → assign confidence → group by objectives → table.
ln-producto_product_vision_board:
Take the product description or briefing I paste and complete the five blocks of Roman Pichler's Product Vision Board: Vision (one aspirational sentence), Target Group (2-3 segments with a differentiating trait), Needs (3-5 key problems it solves), Product (value proposition and differentiating characteristics in 2-3 sentences, no feature list), and Business Goals (2-4 measurable indicators). If data is missing, infer reasonably and declare the assumptions. At the end, write a coherence note of two to three sentences evaluating whether the five blocks reinforce each other. If the vision turns out to be generic, reframe it with greater specificity.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Read briefing → draft the 5 blocks → verify coherence between blocks → declare assumptions.
ln-producto_estrategia_playing_to_win:
Take the business or product context I paste and complete the Playing to Win strategic cascade (Lafley & Martin) with its five questions: Winning Aspiration (what kind of company they want to be), Where to Play (which markets, segments, and channels they compete in and which they don't), How to Win (the differential advantage that makes customers choose them), Necessary Capabilities (3-5 key organizational capabilities), and Management Systems (metrics and routines that sustain those capabilities). Answer each question with 3-6 specific sentences. At the end, write a 'Coherence Test' of 2-3 sentences evaluating whether the five answers reinforce or contradict each other. Declare all assumptions you use.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Read context → answer 5 questions → verify coherence → declare assumptions.
ln-producto_okr_producto:
Take the strategic focuses or initiatives I paste and formulate the product OKRs for the quarter. Define between 2 and 4 qualitative and inspiring Objectives (without operational verbs like 'launch' or 'build'). For each Objective, draft 2-4 Key Results that are measurable, with an identifiable baseline, a specific target value, and verifiable at the close of the quarter. For each KR, apply the Cynicism Test in one sentence: can it be fulfilled without achieving the objective? If yes, reframe it. Flag KRs without an available baseline with [BASELINE PENDING]. The total number of KRs must not exceed 12. Deliver a document per objective with KRs below and a summary table at the end.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Identify focuses → draft Objectives → formulate KRs → apply cynicism test → summary table.
ln-producto_product_strategy_stack:
Take the strategic elements I paste — it can be any combination of mission, vision, company strategy, product strategy, and roadmap — and build or audit the Reforge Product Strategy Stack with its five levels. For the levels that are missing, draft a proposal marked as [PROPOSAL]. For each transition between levels, write a traceability sentence explaining how the lower level derives from the upper level. Identify gaps or contradictions and group them in a 'Gaps and Tensions' section. If the roadmap has items that do not connect to the strategy, call them 'orphan items'. Declare all assumptions.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Map existing levels → propose missing ones → traceability sentence → gaps → complete stack.
ln-producto_tema_apuesta_confianza:
Take the roadmap initiatives I paste and classify them into three confidence levels: High confidence (solid validation evidence), Medium confidence (reasonable hypotheses with partial evidence), and Speculative bet (little or no evidence). Justify the classification of each initiative in one sentence. For medium confidence and speculative ones, propose a concrete uncertainty-reduction action (interviews, prototype, A/B test). Calculate the percentage of the roadmap at each level and issue a health assessment: a healthy roadmap concentrates high confidence in the near horizon. If more than 70% are speculative, recommend a discovery cycle before planning. Declare the confidence scale used at the start.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Define scale → classify → justify → reduction actions → percentages → roadmap health.
ln-producto_pestel_producto:
Conduct a PESTEL analysis of the product environment I describe. For each of the six dimensions (Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Ecological, Legal), identify 2-4 factors relevant specifically to this product — not generic ones. Indicate for each whether it is an Opportunity, Threat, or Neutral factor, and its time horizon (short <6 months, medium 6-24 months, long >24 months). Select the 3 most relevant factors from any dimension and develop them with 2-3 sentences each, including a product strategic implication. If there is regulation directly applicable to the product, mark it with ⚠. Declare the industry and geographic market you are assuming.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Infer industry and market → scan 6 dimensions → classify impact → select critical factors → strategic implications.
ln-producto_estrategia_oceano_azul:
Apply the Eliminate-Reduce-Raise-Create matrix of Blue Ocean Strategy to the product I describe. First identify the 6-10 factors on which the industry currently competes. Then complete the four quadrants with at least 2 items each and a one-sentence justification per item. With the result, draft the new emerging value proposition in 2-3 sentences and validate that it has a clear focus, divergence from the industry average, and a communicable tagline. Propose that positioning tagline in one sentence. If the 'Create' items are too similar to what already exists, reframe them with more originality. Declare all assumptions about competitive factors you infer.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Identify competitive factors → complete ERRC → value proposition → validate criteria → tagline.
ln-producto_product_principles:
Take the product description and the dilemmas I share and draft between 5 and 8 product principles that guide team decisions. Each principle must be a short affirmative sentence (maximum 10 words) that resolves a real trade-off, followed by 2-3 sentences explaining what it means in practice, and a concrete application example of 2-3 sentences. At least 2 principles must create tension with each other — that is what makes them useful. At the end, include a 'Tensions between principles' section that identifies the 2-3 pairs that may conflict and how to handle them. If the principles all turn out positive with no tension, reframe at least 3 as real decision guides. Declare all assumptions.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Identify recurring trade-offs → draft principles → explain + example → verify tensions → conflicts section.
ln-producto_roadmap_un_solo_slide:
Act as a senior product director expert in executive communication. Take the roadmap initiative list I will paste below and produce a single executive slide: group the initiatives into up to 4 time horizons (Now / Next / Later / Under evaluation), select a maximum of 3 initiatives per horizon ordered by business impact, and present each one with its name in business language, objective in ≤8 words, success metric, and confidence level (High/Medium/Under exploration). Add 3 lines of speaker notes per horizon. If no metrics are defined, propose a proxy and mark it as an assumption. Deliver the table ready to copy into a presentation and the footnotes; no technical jargon.

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that each slide initiative has an explicit business objective before delivering.
ln-producto_alinear_roadmap_estrategia:
Act as a senior product strategy consultant. I will paste the initiative roadmap and the company's strategic objectives. Audit the coherence between both: build an initiative-objective traceability table, score the alignment of each initiative (High/Partial/No alignment), detect the strategic objectives that have no initiative backing them, and produce 5 prioritized recommendations to close the gaps. If you don't have the strategy document, use Retention, Expansion, and Operational Efficiency as default pillars. Deliver the report in Markdown with tables.

Protocolo MetodologIA: before delivering the report, verify that each critical gap has at least one associated recommendation.
ln-producto_definir_pmf_sean_ellis:
Act as a growth and product-market fit specialist. Design for me the complete survey based on the Sean Ellis method to measure whether my product has reached PMF: include the 5 questions adapted to the product I am going to describe, the criteria for selecting the sample (minimum 40 responses from active users in the last month), the interpretation table with thresholds (≥40 % very disappointed = strong PMF), the post-results decision tree, and 3 qualitative follow-up questions to understand the 'why'. If I do not have enough users, let me know and adapt for beta.

Product description: [DESCRIBE PRODUCT AND SEGMENT]

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the 40 % threshold is cited correctly and that the decision tree covers all three result ranges before delivering.
ln-producto_pmf_engine_retencion:
Act as a senior product analyst specializing in retention. I am going to paste my product's cohort retention data. Diagnose whether there is a product-market fit signal using the retention engine: interpret the shape of the curve (does it flatten or fall to zero?), calculate the retention floor with benchmarking by product type, segment the cohorts to see which group retains best, and give me the PMF conclusion with confidence level. Close with 3 concrete actions. If I only have partial data, perform the diagnosis while noting the limitation.

Retention data:
[PASTE COHORT TABLE]

Protocolo MetodologIA: before delivering the diagnosis, verify that the PMF conclusion is supported by the retention floor and not only by early-day retention.
ln-producto_segmento_pmf_alto:
Act as a growth and segmentation consultant specializing in PMF. I have mixed signals in my product: some users love it, others don't. I need to identify the segment where PMF is strongest. With the data I am going to paste (surveys, retention, interviews, or CRM), build: the relevant segmentation framework, a table with PMF Score by segment, the detailed profile of the winning segment, an estimate of its market size, and 3–5 implications for ICP, messaging, and the roadmap. If two segments tie, present them with trade-offs.

Available data:
[PASTE DATA]

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the winning segment has evidence of PMF (not just high one-time satisfaction) before declaring it as such.
ln-producto_value_proposition_canvas:
Act as a product and business strategist expert in the Value Proposition Canvas. With the product and segment description I am going to give you, complete the full canvas: the customer profile (prioritized tasks, pains, and gains) and the value map (products/services, pain relievers, gain creators). Then analyze the fit element by element (fits / partial / does not fit), identify the 3 most critical gaps, and propose concrete actions to close them. If information comes from inference, mark it. Deliver in structured format with tables.

Product and segment:
[DESCRIBE PRODUCT AND SEGMENT]

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that each critical customer pain has an explicit fit evaluation before delivering the analysis.
ln-producto_definir_minimo_amado:
Act as a product director expert in launches with high NPS. I want to define the Minimum Lovable Product of my product: not just the minimum that works, but the minimum that generates genuine love in my target segment. With the product description and list of candidate features I am going to give you, define the specific MLP criteria, evaluate each feature (minimum functional + delight + friction reduction), select the MLP features with justification, estimate effort in T-shirt sizing, and give me 3–5 success metrics that measure love, not just usage.

Product and candidate features:
[DESCRIBE PRODUCT AND FEATURES]

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the MLP includes at least one differentiating delight feature that goes beyond basic functionality before delivering.
ln-producto_pmf_pyramid_dunford:
Act as a senior product positioning consultant. I am going to describe the product, the segment, the current positioning, and the observed symptoms. Diagnose which layer of the PMF Pyramid (unmet need → target customer → value proposition → features → UX) has the greatest weakness, apply April Dunford's positioning framework (alternative competitors, unique attributes, value, most relevant segment), cross both diagnoses to identify the critical layer, generate 3 genuinely distinct repositioning hypotheses, and propose the validation plan for the most promising one. Deliver in structured tables.

Product context:
[DESCRIBE PRODUCT, SEGMENT, CURRENT POSITIONING, AND SYMPTOMS]

Protocolo MetodologIA: before delivering the diagnosis, verify that the 3 repositioning hypotheses are genuinely distinct and that each has its associated validation plan.
ln-producto_lean_canvas_producto:
Act as a startup mentor expert in Lean Canvas. With the product description I am going to give you, complete the 9 Lean Canvas blocks (Problem, Segments, Unique Value Proposition, Solution, Channels, Revenue Streams, Costs, Key Metrics, Unfair Advantage). Mark with [ASSUMPTION] the blocks you infer from context. Then analyze the internal consistency between blocks and identify the 3 riskiest hypotheses with their suggested validation method. Deliver the canvas in structured format.

Product description:
[DESCRIBE PRODUCT OR STARTUP]

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the unique value proposition is specific and differentiated, not a generic statement like 'the best solution for X', before delivering.
ln-producto_definir_icp:
Act as a revenue operations director specializing in B2B SaaS. With the product and customer information I am going to give you, define the Ideal Customer Profile: specific firmographic criteria (industry, size, geography), purchase propensity signals, exclusion criteria, the ICP card ready for sales, and a scoring model to qualify prospects. If there is no customer data, build the ICP from hypotheses about the problem the product solves and mark them as assumptions. Deliver in structured tables.

Product and customer information:
[DESCRIBE PRODUCT AND CUSTOMERS]

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the ICP has at least 2 explicit exclusion criteria and that the scoring model has a defined qualification threshold before delivering.
ln-producto_senales_falta_pmf:
Act as a VP of product expert in PMF diagnosis. Create a complete framework to detect early signals of lack of product-market fit: quantitative signal checklist with thresholds (retention, NPS, churn, activation, % very disappointed), qualitative signal checklist, 5 questions that distinguish a PMF problem from an execution problem, decision tree with actions based on the number of signals detected (<3 / 3–5 / >5), and 5 immediate actions for this week. If you give me the product and current metrics, I will apply the framework directly.

Product and available metrics:
[DESCRIBE PRODUCT AND CURRENT METRICS]

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the framework clearly distinguishes signals of lack of PMF from signals of execution problems before delivering.
ln-producto_positioning_april_dunford:
Act as a positioning consultant expert in April Dunford's method. With the product description, current positioning, and sales feedback I am going to give you, apply the 5 components of the method: (1) real alternative competitors, (2) unique product attributes, (3) business value those attributes deliver, (4) profile of the customer who values that value most, (5) market category that makes the value obvious. Close with a one-page sales narrative ready to use. Translate all technical attributes into business outcomes, never leave them as specs.

Product context:
[DESCRIBE PRODUCT, CURRENT POSITIONING, AND FEEDBACK]

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that each unique attribute has its explicit translation to business value (outcome, not feature) before delivering the positioning.
ln-producto_pmf_score_seguimiento:
Design a complete continuous PMF score tracking system for a digital product with at least 200 active users. Include: (1) a maximum 3-question survey based on the Sean Ellis method with distribution instructions; (2) user segmentation criteria (active vs. casual, tenure cohort); (3) quarterly/monthly measurement cadence; (4) dashboard structure with % 'very disappointed' and cohort trend; (5) action protocol for results < 20 %, 20–40 %, and > 40 %. If the business model is not in the thread, assume monthly B2B SaaS and declare it. Paste the product description and target segment.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare missing context assumptions and proceed without asking unless confidence < 0.85.
ln-producto_disenar_experimento_ab:
Design the complete document for an A/B experiment for the product change you describe. I need: a hypothesis in 'If…then…because…' format, precise definition of control and variant(s), primary OEC metric with up to 2 guardrail metrics, MDE with business justification, random assignment criteria by user, and a launch protocol with stopping criteria. Assume 50/50 traffic and a 10 % baseline conversion rate if you don't receive them — declare them. Include a variant table, metrics table, and launch checklist.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare missing context assumptions and proceed without asking unless confidence < 0.85.
ln-producto_calcular_tamano_muestra:
Calculate the sample size per variant and estimated duration of the A/B experiment from the parameters you give me. Show the formula and step-by-step calculations, then generate a sensitivity table with three MDE scenarios. Assume a two-tailed test, alpha = 0.05, and power = 0.80 if I don't specify them; if daily traffic is missing, use 1,000 eligible users/day and declare it. Include a warning if duration exceeds 8 weeks.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare missing context assumptions and proceed without asking unless confidence < 0.85.
ln-producto_disenar_mvp_test:
Design the most suitable MVP to validate the idea you describe at the minimum possible cost. Identify the 3 highest-risk hypotheses, choose the most appropriate MVP format (fake door, concierge, landing, wizard of oz, etc.) with justification, define 2–3 success metrics with concrete thresholds, and deliver an execution plan with effort estimated in person-days. Include the continue/pivot/stop decision tree. Assume a 2–6 week horizon and technology early adopters if you don't give me more details — declare them.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare missing context assumptions and proceed without asking unless confidence < 0.85.
ln-producto_fake_door_test:
Design a complete fake door test to measure demand for the feature you describe. Give me: (1) two copy variants for the entry point (CTA), (2) post-click flow with a transparent 'coming soon' message and interest registration option, (3) success metrics with a justified CTR threshold, (4) minimum technical setup for tracking, (5) analysis protocol with duration and decision criterion. Assume 500 impressions/day if you don't give me the traffic — declare it.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare missing context assumptions and proceed without asking unless confidence < 0.85.
ln-producto_wizard_of_oz:
Design a Wizard of Oz experiment for the feature you describe: a team member will manually operate what the user perceives as automated. I need: (1) description of the illusion the user will see, (2) manual wizard operation flow with response SLA and templates, (3) validation metrics with thresholds, (4) privacy and ethics protocol, (5) graduation criteria to the real automated system. Assume ≤ 50 interactions/day if you don't give me the volume — declare it.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare missing context assumptions and proceed without asking unless confidence < 0.85.
ln-producto_concierge_mvp:
Design the complete protocol to run a concierge MVP of the service you describe: the team will manually serve the first customers to learn before building the platform. I need: (1) ideal customer profile for the first 5–10 customers, (2) manual service process step by step, (3) ready-to-send acquisition script, (4) learning metrics with concrete questions to answer, (5) transition criteria to the digital product. Assume direct outreach as the channel and ticket ≤ 100 USD if you don't give me the price — declare them.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare missing context assumptions and proceed without asking unless confidence < 0.85.
ln-producto_painted_door_smoke:
Design a complete landing smoke test to measure demand for the value proposition you describe. I need: (1) landing structure with copy by section (headline, subtitle, benefits, CTA), (2) primary CTA and post-conversion flow, (3) test traffic configuration with channel and targeting, (4) conversion metrics with benchmarked thresholds, (5) results interpretation protocol with decision criterion. Assume 300–500 unique visitors as target if you don't give me the budget — declare it.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare missing context assumptions and proceed without asking unless confidence < 0.85.
ln-producto_definir_metrica_oec:
Help me define the Overall Evaluation Criterion (OEC) for the experiment you describe. Evaluate the metric candidates you give me (or propose the most appropriate ones if I don't have them) against quality criteria: sensitivity, directionality, absence of gaming, and alignment with the long-term objective. Select the OEC with justification, define the guardrail metrics, and produce the complete operational definition (formula, unit of analysis, time window, data source). Assume a window of ≤ 4 weeks if I don't specify it — declare it.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare missing context assumptions and proceed without asking unless confidence < 0.85.
ln-producto_analizar_resultado_significa:
Interpret the A/B experiment results I share with you: validate statistical significance, assess whether the effect is practically relevant for the business, verify guardrail metrics, flag the interpretation errors the team might be making (peeking, p-value causality, SRM), and issue a decision recommendation with reasoning. Assume a two-tailed test with alpha = 0.05 if I don't indicate the configuration — declare it.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare missing context assumptions and proceed without asking unless confidence < 0.85.
ln-producto_evitar_peeking_test:
Design a complete anti-peeking protocol for the product team you describe. I need: (1) explanation of the peeking problem with a numerical example showing how the false positive rate inflates, (2) experiment governance rules (who sees what and when), (3) valid statistical alternatives for continuous monitoring (SPRT, always-valid p-values), (4) valid early stopping checklist, (5) intermediate results communication protocol, and (6) guide for responding to business pressures. Assume classic frequentist test if you don't give me the platform — declare them.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare missing context assumptions and proceed without asking unless confidence < 0.85.
ln-producto_backlog_experimentos:
Build a prioritized experiment backlog for the product team you describe. Capture or derive the improvement hypotheses, format each with ID, formalized hypothesis, tentative OEC and affected segment, apply ICE scoring (Impact, Confidence, Ease on a 1–10 scale) with brief justification, sort the backlog and add the dependency map and mutex groups. Include the maintenance protocol with review cadence. Assume ICE framework and maximum 2 experiments in parallel if you don't give me another configuration — declare them.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare missing context assumptions and proceed without asking unless confidence < 0.85.
ln-producto_growth_loop_disenar:
Act as a senior Growth Strategist specializing in product loops. Based on the product description and metrics I will paste below, design a self-reinforcing growth loop: identify the central value moment, propose 3 candidate loops with a text diagram (input → action → output → feedback), analyze friction and cycle time for each, choose the main loop with justification, define 5 metrics with baseline and target, and deliver a 4-week validation roadmap. Assume SaaS B2B with product-led growth if I don't specify otherwise; declare all assumptions at the start. The result should be a document reviewable by the CPO with concrete experiments per stage.

Protocolo MetodologIA: reason through the complete loop before writing, verify that each stage has an observable metric and declare all assumptions at the start.
ln-producto_north_star_experiment_map:
Act as a senior Product Manager expert in experimentation and North Star Metric. With the NSM and the list of experiments I share with you, build: (1) NSM input tree at levels 1 and 2, (2) table mapping each experiment to its corresponding input, (3) detection of inputs without coverage, (4) ICE score per experiment, (5) top 5 for the next sprint with justification, and (6) hypothesis card and success criterion for each. If I don't have a defined NSM, ask me only for that data before continuing. Assume 2-week sprints. Result: table ready for sprint planning.

Protocolo MetodologIA: decompose the NSM before mapping experiments, verify that each experiment has a falsifiable hypothesis and flag the coverage gaps.
ln-producto_plan_user_research:
Act as a senior UX Researcher expert in product research programs. With the context, the pending business decision and the preliminary questions I share with you, design a complete research plan: reformulate the questions as actionable research questions, prioritize them by impact, assign the optimal method to each one with justification, estimate resources, build a 4-week schedule, define the participant profile and list the expected deliverables. Assume solution validation phase and 8 available sessions if I don't indicate otherwise. Result: plan document ready to present to the team.

Protocolo MetodologIA: reformulate the questions before assigning methods, justify each methodological decision with the type of insight it produces and declare the resource assumptions at the start.
ln-producto_elegir_metodo_research:
Act as a Research Methodologist expert in UX and product studies. With the research question I share with you, recommend the most suitable method: classify it on the attitudinal/behavioral and qualitative/quantitative axes, list 3 candidate methods with fit criteria, select the primary one with pros and cons, describe how to execute it (sample, duration, tools, deliverable), propose 1-2 alternatives if the primary is not viable and flag the most common biases with mitigation. Assume access to real users and 2 weeks of time if I don't indicate otherwise. Result: immediately executable decision card.

Protocolo MetodologIA: classify the question on the attitudinal-behavioral and qualitative-quantitative axes before recommending, and make explicit the most common biases of the chosen method.
ln-producto_guia_entrevista_exploratoria:
Act as a senior UX Researcher specializing in exploratory interviews. With the domain or problem and the user segment you share with me, draft an open exploratory interview guide for 60 minutes: interviewer introduction (consent, learner role), 3-4 warm-up questions, 8-12 exploratory questions grouped by thematic area, bank of 5-8 follow-up probes, close with space for the participant and suggested notes for the interviewer in each section. No question should be Yes/No or suggest an answer. Result: guide in a two-column table ready to use without additional briefing.

Protocolo MetodologIA: review each question to eliminate confirmation bias, make sure all are open and group by thematic area before ordering.
ln-producto_test_usabilidad_tareas:
Act as a senior UX Researcher specializing in usability testing. With the product description and the flows to evaluate that I share with you, design a task-based usability test: test objective, 5 first-person scenarios with realistic context (without mentioning the interface), task derived from each scenario, metrics per task (completion, time, errors, SEQ), complete facilitation protocol (welcome, think-aloud, close) and observation sheet. Assume moderated remote test of 60 minutes and 5 tasks if I don't indicate otherwise. No task should mention the interface or the path to follow.

Protocolo MetodologIA: draft tasks without mentioning the interface, verify that each has a binary success criterion and mentally rehearse the protocol before delivering.
ln-producto_reclutar_screener:
Act as a Research Operations specialist expert in recruitment screeners. With the ideal participant profile and the inclusion/exclusion criteria I share with you, write a complete screener: hard filter questions ordered from highest to lowest discard rate (without revealing the criteria), classification questions, conflict of interest question, administration instructions and criteria table with expected answer and action for the recruiter. Assume 8 participants and segment 25-45 years if I don't indicate otherwise. Deliver the form ready for the administration tool and the reference table for the recruiter.

Protocolo MetodologIA: order the screener from highest to lowest discard rate, hide the selection criteria in the question wording and verify that each filter has a clear action for the recruiter.
ln-producto_encuesta_producto:
Act as a Research Methodologist expert in bias-free quantitative survey design. With the survey objective, the user segment and the research questions I share with you, design a survey of maximum 10 minutes: measurable variables per question, attitude questions with balanced Likert scale, standard metrics (NPS, CSAT, CES) where applicable, 1 cross-validation question, order from least to most sensitive with demographics at the end, and expected analysis table per question. Assume satisfaction measurement and pain point detection if I don't indicate otherwise. Result: survey ready to copy into the digital tool.

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify the balance of each scale, eliminate double negatives and compound questions, and confirm that the order does not contaminate subsequent responses.
ln-producto_sintesis_affinity_mapping:
Act as a senior UX Researcher specializing in qualitative analysis. With the session notes or transcripts from the research sessions I share with you, synthesize the findings through affinity mapping: extract atomic notes (1 observation = 1 note), group them by thematic affinity, name the groups with descriptive phrases, identify the key finding of each group, draft actionable insights in the format "Users [X] because [Y], which suggests [opportunity Z]" and prioritize them by frequency and impact. Assume 6–8 sessions unless I indicate otherwise. Output: insight table ready for a prioritization session with the team.

Protocolo MetodologIA: extract atomic notes before grouping, always cite the source of each note, and verify that each insight is supported by evidence from at least 3 different sessions.
ln-producto_research_repository:
Act as a Research Operations specialist expert in research knowledge systems. With the team description, available tools, and typical study types I share with you, design the complete architecture of an atomic research repository: entities and relationships, tag taxonomy, study and atomic note templates, new research ingestion flow, quarterly maintenance protocol, and a 1-page search guide. Use Notion as the default tool unless I indicate otherwise. Output: architecture document with copyable templates and usage guide.

Protocolo MetodologIA: design entities and relationships before templates, ensure each atomic note is self-contained, and document the ingestion flow with clear responsible parties.
ln-producto_top_tasks_analysis:
Act as a senior UX Researcher specializing in Gerry McGovern's Top Tasks method. With the product description and available data I share with you, carry out a complete top tasks analysis: build the long list of candidate tasks from multiple sources, reduce it to 20–30 unique tasks, design the prioritization survey ("choose the 5 most important for you"), define the distribution plan, analyze the results, cross importance with current performance in a matrix, and draft prioritized recommendations. Assume 400 minimum responses and build the list from available sources if I have no prior data. Output: report ready to present to the product team.

Protocolo MetodologIA: build the long list from multiple sources before designing the survey, eliminate business tasks disguised as user tasks, and verify vote concentration before declaring the top tasks.
ln-producto_card_sorting:
Act as an Information Architect and UX Researcher specializing in card sorting. With the study objective, the list of content or features, and the existing categories I share with you, design and execute a complete card sorting study: choose the type (open, closed, or hybrid) with justification, prepare 30–50 cards in user language, draft the participant instructions, define the facilitation protocol or tool guide, analyze the results (emerging groups, ambiguous items, agreement among participants), and deliver an information architecture proposal. Assume 15–20 participants and open sorting if the objective is discovery. Output: document ready to execute the study and prototype it.

Protocolo MetodologIA: select the sorting type based on the objective before preparing the cards, detect ambiguous items in the analysis, and translate the emerging groups into a justified architecture proposal.
ln-producto_diario_estudio:
Design a complete longitudinal diary study for a frequently used digital product. Assume a duration of 7–14 days with real active users unless something different is specified. Deliverable: research questions, recruitment criteria, onboarding instructions for participants, daily entry template (≤5 min response, mix of scale+open), calendar with intermediate check-ins, incentive and participant communication protocol, and analysis guide at the close. All in a structured document with tables and templates ready to copy. Paste the product description below.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Actionable artifacts, explicit assumptions, no intermediate steps for the team.
ln-producto_research_insight_recomendaci:
Take the research findings I will paste below and convert them into actionable insights. For each insight: formulate the statement about the user (subject + verb + context + consequence), attach 1–3 supporting pieces of evidence, estimate the impact (High/Medium/Low with a one-line justification), write a concrete recommendation with an action verb, and suggest the responsible party by role. Order from highest to lowest impact. Maximum 8 insights in a table or structured list. If there are contradictions among participants, document them as an ambiguity insight.

Protocolo MetodologIA: No theory, only executable synthesis; explicit assumptions; artifact ready to share.
ln-producto_nps_driver_analysis:
Analyze the NPS data I will paste below. Classify responses into Promoters, Passives, and Detractors, calculate the net NPS, and group comments by recurring themes. Identify the top 3 positive drivers and top 3 negative drivers with evidence. For each negative driver estimate the potential impact if resolved and formulate a specific recommendation with its tracking metric. Deliver an executive table and a narrative analysis by segment. Declare assumptions when the material is insufficient.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Verifiable figures, explicit assumptions, report ready for management.
ln-producto_user_story_mapping:
Build an end-to-end user story map for the product I will describe. Identify the user's main objective, define the backbone of 5–8 activities in chronological sequence, and break each one down into 3–6 specific tasks. Create at least two release slices (MVP, V1, Future) with explicit inclusion criteria. Flag 2–3 critical gaps that need validation. Deliver the map as a structured table: backbone in the first row, tasks below, release slices marked. Declare assumptions if context is missing.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Concise backbone, justified slices, actionable gaps.
ln-producto_refinamiento_backlog:
Prepare a complete backlog refinement session. Design an agenda with timeboxes for 60–90 minutes, a Definition of Ready with binary criteria (maximum 8), a refinement question guide per story, and a refined story template with narrative, Given-When-Then acceptance criteria, estimation, dependencies, and technical notes. Include a tiebreaker protocol when the team does not reach consensus. If you paste the stories to refine, apply the guide directly. Everything must be reusable in future sessions.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Reusable artifacts, respected timebox, binary criteria.
ln-producto_dividir_historias_grandes:
Split the large stories I will paste below into smaller stories with independent value. For each one: diagnose why it is large, choose the most suitable splitting pattern (workflow steps, data variations, business rules, simple vs. complex, etc.) and generate the child stories in the format "As a… I want… so that…" with minimum acceptance criteria and relative size (XS/S/M). Verify that each child story passes the INVEST test. Deliver: diagnosis, chosen pattern with justification, and list of child stories ordered by logical sequence.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Named pattern, INVEST verified, delivery ready for refinement.
ln-producto_definir_epica_iniciativa:
From the initiative I will describe, build the complete product hierarchy: start with a value hypothesis ("We believe that… will achieve… measured by…"), break it down into 2-4 epics with exit criteria, define 2-4 features per epic with acceptance criteria, and write 3-5 user stories per feature. Indicate dependencies between epics and 2-3 critical risks to validate before investing. Deliver the complete hierarchical tree.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Hypothesis with metric, navigable tree, risks before building.
ln-producto_grooming_dependencias:
Take the backlog items I will paste below and map all the dependencies between them. For each dependency indicate: which item blocks which, type (technical/functional/team/external), and criticality (Blocker/High/Medium). Propose an implementation sequence that minimizes blockers and define one mitigation action per Blocker or High dependency. Flag items with no dependencies that can be parallelized. Deliver the dependency table and recommended sequence.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Typed dependencies, actionable sequence, mitigations with owner.
ln-producto_dual_track_discovery:
Design the dual-track discovery operating system for the team I will describe: weekly rhythm cadence, board with columns and movement criteria, criteria for entering discovery and exiting to delivery, simplified RACI, a discovery brief template for handoff, and system health metrics. The system should add no more than 2 weekly ceremony hours and be executable without additional resources. Declare assumptions about the team if not specified.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Executable system, handoff as artifact, metrics from sprint 1.
ln-producto_definir_outcome_discovery:
From the target outcome I will describe, frame the discovery: restate the outcome as a measurable statement, write the central opportunity question, and build the first-level opportunity tree (3-5 opportunities with 2-3 sub-opportunities each). Identify the 3 riskiest assumptions in the tree and design a 2-4 week discovery plan to validate them. Define the evidence threshold for committing to an opportunity. Do not include solutions in the tree.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Measurable outcome, solution-free tree, falsifiable assumptions.
ln-producto_backlog_health_audit:
Audit the backlog I will paste below. Evaluate the following dimensions on a 1-5 scale: Clarity, Completeness, Prioritization, Currency, Hierarchical Coherence, and Story Size. Identify the 5-10 most problematic items with a specific diagnosis. Calculate the overall score and interpret the health status. Produce a prioritized remediation plan (actions + effort + owner) for dimensions scoring below 3 and define a preventive maintenance ritual.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Numeric scorecard, specific diagnosis, actionable plan.
ln-producto_idea_triage_inbox:
Take the inbox of ideas and requests I will paste below and apply structured triage. For each entry: assign an ID, classify by type, evaluate it on user impact, estimated effort, and strategic alignment (1-3 scale each), calculate the total score, and assign a destination (Advance ≥7, Defer 5-6, Reject ≤4). For "Advance" entries define the concrete next step. For rejected ones draft the response message. Deliver the complete table and list of immediate actions.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Objective criteria, communications included, table ready to update.
ln-producto_definir_mvp_slice: Given the product context you paste below, identify the thinnest possible walking skeleton for the first MVP: list the candidate features, decide which ones go IN, OUT, or DEFER using the criterion "without this, does the main flow break?", then write a 5-7 step usage narrative, 3-5 acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then, and 2-3 blocking technical risks with mitigation. If context is missing, declare a reasonable assumption and proceed. Deliver a document ready for the team to start developing without additional meetings.
ln-producto_estimacion_planning_poker: Act as a Scrum Master facilitating a planning poker session. With the user stories I paste below, analyze complexity, uncertainty, and dependencies; assign story points in Fibonacci sequence (1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 20, 40, 100) with justification per story; propose splitting any story larger than 8 points; and deliver a final table with ID, title, points, justification, and risk signal, plus a 3-5 sentence executive summary. If a story has no acceptance criteria, estimate it in the high range and flag it.
ln-producto_backlog_anti_aging: Act as a senior Product Owner and audit the backlog I paste below. Apply an explicit expiration policy: classify each item as CURRENT, EXPIRED, DUPLICATE, or REFINEMENT REQUIRED with justification; document the policy as reusable rules; generate the sanitized backlog with only current items ordered by perceived value. If there are no creation dates, infer expiration from textual context. If more than 60% is expired, warn that a vision session is needed before re-prioritizing.
ln-producto_journey_map_actual: Build the current-state customer journey map for the user profile and objective I describe below. Document 5-8 stages with actions, channel, predominant thought, and emotion (Happy/Neutral/Frustrated/Desperate). Identify the 3-5 most critical pain points, mark the moments of truth, and generate an improvement opportunities table ordered by impact/effort. If evidence is missing, use explicit assumptions marked as [ASSUMPTION] and recommend 3 priority research questions.
ln-producto_service_blueprint: Build a complete service blueprint for the service I describe below. Document per stage: customer actions, frontstage, line of visibility, backstage, support systems, and digital/physical evidence. Then identify the operational gaps where frontstage and backstage are out of sync, and generate an improvement opportunities table with type (Automation/Coordination/Redesign) and impact. If internal system information is missing, use explicit assumptions marked as [ASSUMPTION].
ln-producto_definir_problema_pov: Act as a design thinking facilitator and formulate the POV statement for the problem based on the research data I paste below. Use the format: [User] needs [need] because [insight]. Generate 2 alternative variants and verify the main statement against 4 criteria: user-centered, defines problem not solution, revealing insight, actionable for ideation. If the identified need is a disguised solution, reframe it explicitly. If the data lacks an insight, flag it as [ASSUMPTION] and recommend the necessary research.
ln-producto_how_might_we: Transform the problem or POV statement I paste below into "How Might We...?" questions using at least 5 types of reframing: amplify, reduce, change the actor, invert, challenge assumptions, exploit the constraint, analogy. Generate at least 10 HMW questions in a table with reframe type and disruptive potential; select the 3 most promising with justification; and provide 2-3 voting criteria for the team. No HMW should suggest a specific solution.
ln-producto_jobs_forces_diagram: Analyze the four forces of customer progress according to the Jobs to Be Done framework for the context I describe below. For each force — Push of the current problem, Pull toward the new solution, Anxiety about change, Attachment to habit — generate 3-5 specific phrases with intensity from 1 to 10. Calculate the pro-change vs. anti-change balance, diagnose whether the customer is ready to adopt, and generate 3-5 product or marketing recommendations to resolve the imbalance.
ln-producto_outcome_driven_innovation: Apply Tony Ulwick's Outcome-Driven Innovation (ODI) method to the job-to-be-done I describe below. Generate 10-15 desired outcomes in ODI format (Minimize/Maximize [metric] when [action]), record or estimate importance and satisfaction (1-10), calculate the opportunity score (Importance + max(Importance - Satisfaction, 0)), classify outcomes as Underserved/Overserved/Well-served, and identify the 3-5 with the highest opportunity score with a concrete solution direction for each.
ln-producto_validar_problema_severidad: Design a severity and frequency validation plan for the user problem I describe below. Define severity scales (4 levels) and frequency scales (5 levels), build the matrix with decision thresholds (invest/investigate/defer), propose 3-5 interview questions to place the problem in the matrix, recommend 2-3 research methods, and establish the decision threshold. If data is available, analyze the current placement with confidence level.
ln-producto_segmentar_jtbd: Segment the market for the product I describe using the Jobs to Be Done framework. Identify the primary functional job and generate 3-5 variants with different contexts; for each, define the associated emotional and social jobs; build the segments table with representative profile, current solution, relative size, and monetization potential; evaluate with urgency, frequency, and willingness to pay; prioritize the top 2-3 highest-opportunity segments and recommend the ideal entry segment for launch.
ln-producto_definir_anti_personas: Define 3-5 anti-personas for the product I describe: users who are explicitly NOT the target. For each one, document the profile, the reasons for incompatibility with the product, the negative impact of trying to serve them, and 3-5 early detection signals to identify them in the sales or onboarding process. Close with a decision criteria table that the commercial team can use without consulting the product owner.
ln-producto_mapa_competitivo_jtbd:
Act as a product strategist expert in Jobs-To-Be-Done. Based on the product description I share, build a competitive map organized by the job users are trying to complete, not by software category. First declare the primary job (functional, emotional, and social). Then list at least 8 competitors — direct, indirect, and non-consumption — and evaluate on a scale of 1-5 how well each one fulfills each dimension of the job, with a brief justification. Identify 2-3 white spaces where no rival satisfies the job well and formulate a differential positioning opportunity in ≤ 2 sentences. Deliver a markdown table plus white-space and opportunity sections. If no product information is provided, ask only for the name or URL.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare job → map competitors → evaluate dimensions → identify spaces → formulate positioning.
ln-producto_pirate_metrics_funnel:
Act as a growth analyst expert in AARRR funnels. With the data or symptom description I share about my product funnel, build a complete diagnosis: table with the 5 stages (Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Referral, Revenue), key metrics, conversion rates between stages, and a health traffic light compared against industry benchmark. Identify the primary bottleneck and generate 3 concrete improvement hypotheses with the metric that would move and the estimated impact. If I use incomplete data, work with what is available, declare assumptions, and keep going. Deliver a markdown table plus bottleneck and hypotheses sections.

Protocolo MetodologIA: map AARRR → calculate conversions → compare benchmark → identify bottleneck → generate prioritized hypotheses.
ln-producto_modelo_aha_onboarding:
Act as a product designer specialized in onboarding and activation. Based on my product description and its current onboarding flow, help me redesign the new-user experience oriented toward the aha moment. First define that moment with precision in the format "The user [verb] [object] and experiences [benefit]". Then audit the current flow in a table identifying friction points and improvement proposals per step. Design the minimum viable flow toward the aha in ≤ 5 steps, removing everything that does not contribute to reaching the value. Finally, define the activation metric: the event, threshold, and time window that confirm the user reached the aha moment. If I do not know my aha moment, infer it from the value proposition and mark it as an assumption.

Protocolo MetodologIA: define aha → audit flow → propose minimum flow → assign activation metric.
ln-consulting_priorizacion_problemas_mat:
Act as a strategic consultant expert in prioritization. I have a list of problems identified in a diagnostic and I need to know which to tackle first. Based on the list and context I share with you, evaluate each problem on a 1-5 scale for Impact (on the business objective) and Effort (time, resources, and complexity). Classify each in the four quadrants of the impact-effort matrix: Quick Wins, Strategic Projects, Fill-ins, and Avoid. Deliver a markdown table with scores and brief justifications, followed by a 3-horizon roadmap (immediate, medium-term, low priority) and the critical assumptions that could alter the prioritization. If the business objective is unclear, infer it from context or ask me a single question.

Protocolo MetodologIA: define objective → evaluate impact/effort → assign quadrants → order priorities → generate roadmap.
ln-consulting_definicion_problema_con_5w:
Act as a senior diagnostic consultant. Based on the problem description the client shares with me, build a complete 5W2H card: answer What? Why? Who? When? Where? How? How much? in a markdown table. First verify that the client's description is a real problem and not a solution in disguise — if it is, reframe it in terms of a performance gap. Then draft a problem statement in a single sentence in the format: "[Who] cannot [achieve what] in [context] because [cause], which generates [impact]". Close with 2-3 validation questions to confirm the definition with the client. Mark as [ASSUMPTION] any dimension not present in the inputs.

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify framing → answer 5W2H → draft statement → validate with questions.
ln-consulting_replanteo_de_problema_con_:
Act as a strategic innovation consultant expert in reframing. I have a problem defined in a certain way and I want to explore whether that definition is limiting the solutions. Based on the problem I share with you, first identify the assumptions that are constraining it. Then generate 4 reformulations from the perspectives: stakeholder, temporal, scale, and opposite. For each reformulation, list 2 solutions it enables that the original definition did not allow us to see. Evaluate each reformulation on solution-space breadth and feasibility (1-5) in a table. Finally, recommend the reformulation that should guide the team's work going forward and justify why. If the original problem is not clear, infer it from context.

Protocolo MetodologIA: document original → identify assumptions → generate reformulations → evaluate space → recommend reframe.
ln-consulting_alcance_y_no_alcance_del_e:
Act as an engagement manager expert in defining scope for consulting projects. Based on the project objective and context I share with you, build the Scope and Out-of-Scope document for the engagement. Include: the central objective in one sentence, the deliverables table with observable acceptance criteria, the explicit exclusions table with reason for exclusion, the gray zone with decision criteria for each ambiguous topic, and the scope change management process in case new requests arise. The document must be signable by client and consultant as a formal agreement. If the objective is not declared, infer it from context and mark it.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare objective → list deliverables with criteria → define exclusions → manage gray zone → establish change process.
ln-consulting_contexto_del_problema_con_:
Act as a strategic context analyst expert in PESTEL frameworks. Based on the problem and sector I share with you, build a PESTEL analysis oriented specifically to the client's problem, not the sector in general. For each dimension (Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Ecological, Legal) identify 2-3 factors with a direct connection to the problem, evaluate their impact (High/Medium/Low) and time horizon, and classify each as an Opportunity or Threat. Deliver the complete PESTEL table, the 3-5 most critical external forces with their strategic implication in ≤ 20 words each, and 1-2 early warning signals. If a dimension does not apply to the problem, indicate this explicitly. Mark as [ASSUMPTION] any factor without data in the inputs.

Protocolo MetodologIA: connect each PESTEL factor to the problem → evaluate impact and horizon → synthesize critical forces → identify early warnings.
ln-consulting_problema_definicion_con_jo:
Act as a consultant expert in Jobs-To-Be-Done applied to organizational diagnostics. Based on the engagement problem and context I share with you, identify the 2-3 main actors and infer the job each is trying to complete using the format "When [situation], I want to [motivation], so that [outcome]". Break down each job into its functional, emotional, and social dimensions. Identify the friction points that prevent completing the job with the current process or system. Reframe the project's problem as a gap in the job, not as an organizational symptom. Close with the unaddressed jobs that could be additional opportunities. If the actors are not declared, infer them from context.

Protocolo MetodologIA: identify actors → declare complete jobs → map friction → reframe problem as gap → flag unaddressed jobs.
ln-consulting_costo_de_no_actuar_cost_of:
Act as a business consultant expert in impact analysis and business cases. I need to quantify the cost of inaction on the problem I share with you to justify urgency to the client. Based on the problem description and available data, identify the 3 most relevant impact dimensions (financial, operational, strategic, reputational, etc.), estimate the monthly cost of inaction for each with its calculation hypothesis, and project the cumulative CoI at 6 months, 1 year, and 3 years in a table. Build the urgency argument in ≤ 3 sentences that explain why acting now. Close with the trigger events that would accelerate the cost. Use conservative ranges and mark all assumptions.

Protocolo MetodologIA: identify impact dimensions → estimate monthly cost → project horizons → build urgency argument → flag triggers.
ln-consulting_brief_de_problema_para_kic:
Act as a strategic communications consultant. I need a problem brief ready to distribute before the kickoff. Based on all available information I share with you, draft a 1-page document with 6 sections: Context (2-3 sentences about the situation), Problem Statement (performance gap, no solutions), Affected Actors (3-5 with one line of impact each), Impact of Inaction (2-3 concrete consequences), Constraints and Assumptions (3-5 items), and Open Questions for the Kickoff (3-5 questions). Professional and direct tone. If information is missing, infer based on context and mark it [ASSUMPTION]. Objective: everyone arrives at the kickoff with the same understanding without needing extensive prior reading.

Protocolo MetodologIA: synthesize context → declare problem → list actors → quantify inaction impact → document constraints → formulate open questions.
ln-consulting_taxonomia_de_sintomas_vs_c:
Act as an organizational diagnostic consultant expert in root cause analysis. I have a list of diagnostic findings that mixes symptoms and causes, and I need to separate them rigorously. First classify each finding as a symptom, direct cause, or hypothetical root cause, flagging any ambiguity. Then apply the 5 Whys principle to the 2-3 most critical symptoms to reach the root causes. Build the cause tree in hierarchical text format and flag the highest-leverage root causes: those that, when resolved, would eliminate the most symptoms. If all findings are symptoms, propose hypothetical causes to explore.

Protocolo MetodologIA: classify findings → apply 5 Whys → build tree → identify highest-leverage root causes.
ln-consulting_mapa_de_supuestos_criticos: Act as a senior strategy consultant. Given the problem statement or solution hypothesis I will paste below, build a critical assumptions map: list all implicit and explicit assumptions (minimum 8), classify them by type, impact, and uncertainty level, position them in a 2x2 matrix of impact vs. uncertainty, and identify the critical assumptions (high impact + high uncertainty). For each critical assumption define a validation question, data source, and estimated effort in days. Deliver a classified table + ASCII matrix + validation plan in a structured block. If I do not paste the input, ask for it before continuing. Protocolo MetodologIA: label each statement with [INFERENCE] or [ASSUMPTION] as appropriate.
ln-consulting_descomposicion_de_palancas: Act as a senior corporate value consultant. With the business model description I will paste, build a value lever decomposition tree: start from the root value indicator (EBITDA, FCF, or another you identify), decompose it into MECE components down to the third level, assign relative impact weights to each lever, and select the top 3–5 priority levers with justification and immediate actions. If I have no financial data, work qualitatively and flag what data would be needed. Deliver an indented text tree with weights + priorities table. Label with [ASSUMPTION] every estimate not supported by data. Protocolo MetodologIA: never invent figures without [ASSUMPTION].
ln-consulting_arbol_de_drivers_de_rentab: Act as a senior financial consultant specializing in profitability. With the business information I will paste, build a profitability driver tree from the root indicator (net margin, ROE, or another you identify) down to the operational drivers at the deepest level (max 4 levels, MECE). Estimate each driver's gap vs. industry benchmark, identify the 3–5 most critical drivers, and propose for each one a concrete operational intervention with a tracking KPI. Label with [ASSUMPTION] every benchmark not confirmed by the user. Deliver an indented tree + priority drivers table. Protocolo MetodologIA: label every figure not provided by the user.
ln-consulting_analisis_de_pareto_80_20: Act as a senior business analyst. With the table or list I will paste, perform an 80/20 Pareto analysis: sort the elements from highest to lowest, calculate the cumulative %, identify the vital subset that explains ~80% of the result, and flag each element as vital or trivial. Generate a sorted table with flags, relative bar visualization, analysis of patterns in the vital subset (including concentration risks), and 3–5 strategic focus recommendations. If I do not paste data with numerical values, ask for them before continuing. Protocolo MetodologIA: label [ASSUMPTION] any estimate not provided by the user.
ln-consulting_segmentacion_de_clientes_p: Act as a senior customer portfolio management consultant. With the data or description of the customer base I will paste, build a value-based segmentation: define the relevant value variables, create between 3 and 5 MECE segments with quantitative criteria, describe the profile of each one (size, revenue/margin contribution, churn risk), design a differentiated management strategy per segment, and define 2–3 tracking KPIs. Close with a resource prioritization recommendation across segments. Label with [ASSUMPTION] every estimate without the user's data. Protocolo MetodologIA: never invent figures without marking them.
ln-consulting_descomposicion_de_costos_p: Act as a senior operational costs consultant. With the activity, process, and cost information I will paste, build an ABC costing model: identify resource pools and their cost drivers, assign resources to activities and activities to cost objects (products, services, or customers), calculate the real unit cost per cost object, and compare it with price/revenue to determine profitability. Deliver a cost flow table (resources → activities → objects), a profitability ranking of objects, and a list of non-value-added activities with an efficiency recommendation. Label with [ASSUMPTION] every estimate without the user's data. Protocolo MetodologIA: never invent figures.
ln-consulting_analisis_de_brechas_gap_an: Act as a senior organizational transformation consultant. With the description of the current state and target state I will paste, perform a complete gap analysis: identify the relevant dimensions (strategy, processes, technology, people, data, or others), describe the current and target situation in each with observable criteria, rate the gap 1–5, build the summary table, and prioritize in an urgency × impact matrix. For the 3–5 most critical gaps, design closing initiatives with activities, suggested owner, timeline, and closing metric. If the current state or target is missing, ask for it before continuing. Protocolo MetodologIA: label [ASSUMPTION] on every estimated rating.
ln-consulting_matriz_2x2_para_estructura: Act as a senior strategy consultant. With the decision description and options I will paste, design the most discriminating 2x2 matrix: select the two axes with the greatest differentiating power among options (and justify your choice), position each option in the matrix with 2–3 lines of justification, name the four quadrants with actionable labels, and interpret the emerging pattern. Close with a specific and conditional strategic recommendation. Deliver the matrix in ASCII + positioning table + recommendation. Protocolo MetodologIA: label [ASSUMPTION] on every estimated positioning.
ln-consulting_analisis_de_sensibilidad_d: Act as a senior financial analyst. With the model and variables I will paste, perform the complete sensitivity analysis: for each independent variable, calculate the impact on the result indicator when varying ±10%, ±20%, and ±30% (ceteris paribus), build the sensitivity table and the ASCII tornado diagram ordered by magnitude of impact. Identify the 3–5 most critical variables, classify them by controllability (internal/external) and predictability, and propose concrete mitigation or exploitation actions for each. Label with [ASSUMPTION] every estimate without the user's data. Protocolo MetodologIA: never invent figures.
ln-consulting_descomposicion_de_la_pregu: Act as a senior strategy consultant. With the key question I will paste, perform the complete MECE decomposition: reformulate the question to ensure it is specific and actionable, build the sub-question tree of 2–3 levels (each level MECE), propose a preliminary hypothesis with rationale for each last-level sub-question, and indicate the required analysis, data sources, and estimated effort per branch. Flag the branches of highest uncertainty or impact. If the question is very broad, ask me 1–2 clarifying questions before continuing. Protocolo MetodologIA: label [ASSUMPTION] on every hypothesis without data support.
ln-consulting_modelo_de_unit_economics: Act as a senior digital-business analyst. Using the business model type and the metrics I will paste, build the complete unit economics model: calculate CAC, LTV, contribution margin, payback period and LTV/CAC with explicit formulas; compare against industry benchmarks; run a sensitivity analysis on the 3 most critical drivers against LTV/CAC; build base, optimistic and pessimistic scenarios; diagnose the health of the unit economics; and propose 3-5 concrete improvement actions with estimated impact on the ratios. Tag every benchmark or estimated figure with [ASSUMPTION]. Protocolo MetodologIA: never invent figures.
ln-consulting_analisis_de_correlacion_de: Act as a senior business data analyst. Using the data or description I will paste, run the correlation analysis between candidate drivers and the outcome indicator: calculate or estimate the correlation coefficients, build the table ordered by magnitude (with strong/moderate/weak classification), and for the 3-5 most correlated drivers formulate a causality hypothesis with an explicit logical mechanism. Flag spurious or surprising correlations, warn about confounding variables and propose next steps to move from correlation to causation. Never assert causation from correlation alone. Protocolo MetodologIA: tag [ASSUMPTION] on correlations estimated without hard data.
ln-consulting_modelo_de_dimensionamiento:
Build a market sizing model with top-down and bottom-up approaches for the context I will paste. Start from the total market (TAM) using macro data, filter down to SAM and SOM, then reconcile with a bottom-up calculation from the minimum business unit (typical customer, ticket, frequency). Deliver a comparative table with pessimistic/base/optimistic scenarios, list numbered critical assumptions and write a 3-sentence executive paragraph. If the methods differ by more than 50%, explain the cause and recommend which data point to validate. Label as [ASSUMPTION] every figure inferred without a primary source.

Protocolo MetodologIA: rigorous top-down + bottom-up sizing, explicit assumptions, ready for executive committee.
ln-consulting_estructuracion_con_marco_d:
Apply the 3C framework (Company, Customers, Competition) to the context you are about to receive. For each dimension identify 3-5 points with declared evidence or assumption. Then cross the three dimensions to find up to 3 opportunities where the company can win at what the customer values and the competition does not offer. Close with 2-3 actionable strategic implications and a success indicator for each. If competitor information is missing, use public benchmarks and label them [ASSUMPTION].

Protocolo MetodologIA: structured 3C analysis with opportunity intersections and prioritized recommendations.
ln-consulting_validacion_de_hipotesis_co:
Take the hypotheses I am about to give you and apply an adversarial validation process: for each one, define 2-3 conditions that would falsify it, look in the context for evidence approaching those conditions, evaluate the strength of that evidence and issue a verdict (strong/moderate/weak) with a recommended action (maintain/refine/discard). If a hypothesis is unfalsifiable as currently formulated, reformulate it in a testable version. Close with a paragraph flagging the most vulnerable hypotheses. Label with [ASSUMPTION] everything inferred without available data.

Protocolo MetodologIA: active falsification of hypotheses with solidity verdicts and follow-up recommendations.
ln-consulting_diseno_de_analisis_para_pr:
Take the project hypotheses I am about to give you and design an analysis plan for each one. Per hypothesis specify: how to reformulate it as a testable question with a binary outcome, what type of analysis is most efficient (quantitative/qualitative/benchmark), what minimum data are needed and where they come from, what specific methodology to apply, the estimated effort in person-hours and the criterion that would indicate the hypothesis was confirmed or refuted. If two hypotheses share the same analysis, consolidate them. Close with an execution-risks note.

Protocolo MetodologIA: executable analytical workplan with methodology and clear confirmation criteria per hypothesis.
ln-consulting_priorizacion_de_hipotesis_:
Take the project hypotheses I am about to give you and prioritize them by information value. For each one, score 1 to 5 the impact on the client's decision if it turned out to be false and the current uncertainty (how little is known). Multiply both to get the information value. Add a research-cost valuation (high/medium/low) to make the ranking pragmatic. Deliver the table ordered from highest to lowest value and a paragraph justifying the 3 hypotheses the team should investigate first.

Protocolo MetodologIA: information value scoring = impact x uncertainty, adjusted by research cost.
ln-consulting_storyboard_de_respuesta_em:
Build a ghost deck (emerging-response storyboard) of 10 slides based on the project context you are about to receive. Each slide must have a title that is a complete message (sentence with subject and verb), the visualization that would best communicate it, the hypothesis or evidence supporting it and the progress status: CONFIRMED, PROVISIONAL or TO INVESTIGATE. Organize the narrative in three acts: context/problem, analysis/findings, recommendation. Close with a note on the pending analyses needed to complete the deck.

Protocolo MetodologIA: ghost deck with 3-act narrative structure, titles as messages and evidence status per slide.
ln-consulting_diseno_de_experimento_para:
Design an experiment to validate the solution I am about to describe. Define the validation question in causal terms, formulate the null hypothesis (H0) and alternative hypothesis (H1) with the primary metric, design the experimental structure (control and treatment groups, or pre/post if randomization is not possible), specify the success metrics with numeric thresholds, identify the most relevant confounding variables and estimate the minimum duration. Close with a decision tree: what to do at the end according to the result.

Protocolo MetodologIA: experimental design with H0/H1, metrics with thresholds and decision tree to scale, modify or discard.
ln-consulting_test_de_significancia_de_h:
Apply a significance test to the diagnostic findings I am about to give you. For each one, score 1 to 5: Materiality (quantitative business impact), Actionability (can the client act within 12 months) and Novelty (does it contribute something non-obvious). Sum the scores and classify each finding as SIGNIFICANT (>=10), CONTEXT (6-9) or DISCARD (<6). For SIGNIFICANT ones, draft the executive message in a single sentence with subject, verb and impact.

Protocolo MetodologIA: triple significance test with classification and executive messages ready for the deck.
ln-consulting_matriz_de_evidencia_por_hi:
Build a double-entry matrix that crosses the project hypotheses with the available evidence sources. In each cell indicate whether the source supports (++), partially supports (+), is not relevant (—), or contradicts (✗) the hypothesis, and add the source quality (A/B/C). Calculate the consolidated verdict per hypothesis (CONFIRMED/PROBABLE/UNCERTAIN/REFUTED) and list the evidence gaps where cells remain empty in critical hypotheses.

Protocolo MetodologIA: hypothesis × evidence matrix with verdicts and gaps to close the analysis.
ln-consulting_triangulacion_de_fuentes_d:
Triangulate the available evidence sources for the project findings I am going to share. For each finding, identify which sources support it, whether they converge, diverge, or some type of source is missing. Classify the relationship as CONVERGENCE, DIVERGENCE, or GAP and issue a robustness judgment: ROBUST (≥2 aligned source types), PROVISIONAL (single source), or IN TENSION (active divergence). For those IN TENSION, recommend what additional data or analysis would resolve the discrepancy.

Protocolo MetodologIA: source triangulation with robustness judgments and recommendations to resolve divergences.
ln-consulting_falsacion_rapida_de_supues:
Take the business plan or strategy I am about to share and extract all critical assumptions (explicit and implicit, minimum 5). Classify them by criticality (if false, does it destroy the plan?) and uncertainty (how little is known?). Prioritize the 3-5 highest-risk ones and for each design the fastest and cheapest possible falsification test: what you would do, what result would indicate it is false, how much time and money it would cost. Flag any assumption that already shows negative signals as ACTIVE ALERT.

Protocolo MetodologIA: rapid falsification with risk map, low-cost tests, and alert indicators to protect the investment.
ln-consulting_arbol_de_decision_bajo_inc:
Build a decision tree for the situation I am about to describe. Identify the main decision and the action alternatives (maximum 4), the uncertain events that affect each alternative, the probabilities of each outcome (estimated and marked [ASSUMPTION] if I do not have them), and the values of each final result. Calculate the expected value per alternative and recommend the optimal option. Include sensitivity analysis: what probability would change the recommendation? If a scenario implies catastrophic loss, flag it.

Protocolo MetodologIA: decision tree with expected value and sensitivity analysis for taking complex decisions with quantified logic.
ln-consulting_one_pager_ejecutivo_de_rec: Act as a senior strategy consultant. With the analysis I will paste below, write an executive one-pager in English (max. 600 words) with this structure: Action title → Recommendation in one sentence → Why now (max. 3 quantitative pieces of evidence) → Evaluated and discarded options → Risk of inaction (temporal, financial, or competitive cost) → Next step (imperative verb + responsible party + date). If data is missing, flag it with [ASSUMPTION] and continue; only ask questions if your confidence falls below 0.85. Format ready to copy to a slide or Word document. Protocolo MetodologIA: executive brevity first, evidence markers always.
ln-consulting_executive_summary_con_so_w: Act as a management consultant with experience presenting findings to corporate boards. With the report I will paste below, draft an executive summary (max. 400 words) with an inverted pyramid structure: overall conclusion first, then each main finding immediately followed by its 'so what' (actionable implication for the business in one sentence), closing with 2-3 numbered prioritized recommendations. If data is missing, use [ASSUMPTION] and continue; only ask if confidence drops below 0.85. Protocolo MetodologIA: actionable implication before description.
ln-consulting_storyline_de_presentacion_: Act as a senior strategic communication consultant with Minto/SCQA mastery. With the presentation objective and findings I will paste, build the complete storyline: start with the governing thought (one sentence the audience must remember), design the SCQA opening (situation-complication-question), then 3-4 MECE narrative blocks with an action title, supporting points, and logical transition, and close with a call to action. Format: editable hierarchical outline. If context is sparse, formulate the governing thought as [ASSUMPTION] and proceed; only ask if confidence drops below 0.85. Protocolo MetodologIA: argument before information.
ln-consulting_titulos_de_slide_orientado: Act as a senior executive presentation consultant with Minto mastery. With the list of slide titles and content descriptions I will paste, transform each descriptive title into an action title: a declarative sentence with subject-verb-object that expresses the slide's conclusion, max. 12 words. Deliver a table: Original title | Action title | Justification note. Verify that reading the action titles in sequence narrates the complete story. If a slide's content is unclear, infer the most likely message and mark it [ASSUMPTION]; only ask if your confidence drops below 0.85. Protocolo MetodologIA: conclusion visible in the title, always.
ln-consulting_deck_de_hallazgos_para_com: Act as a consulting director with extensive experience presenting to boards of directors. With the diagnostic context and findings I will paste, design the complete deck structure: governing thought, sections with purpose and slide count, action titles for key slides, suggested evidence type per section, and appendix design for committee questions. The committee will make a high-impact decision in this session. If the findings context is sparse, design it as a template with [CONTENT TO COMPLETE] markers; only ask if confidence drops below 0.85. Protocolo MetodologIA: traceable evidence→insight→implication→recommendation flow in every finding.
ln-consulting_memo_de_decision_para_patr: Act as a senior project manager with experience managing executive sponsor relationships. With the context I will paste, draft a decision memo (max. 500 words) for the project sponsor. Structure: Decision required (first sentence: what, for whom, by when) → Minimum context → Options table (option | implication | risk) → Team recommendation with two-sentence justification → Response mechanism with deadline and consequence of not deciding. If the deadline is missing, use 72 business hours. If data is missing, mark it [ASSUMPTION] and continue; only ask if confidence drops below 0.85. Protocolo MetodologIA: decision first, context after.
ln-consulting_dashboard_ejecutivo_de_kpi: Act as a performance management consultant with expertise in Balanced Scorecard and strategic dashboards. With the objectives and indicators I will paste, design the full structure of the executive KPI dashboard in English: classify by perspective, define traffic-light thresholds (green/yellow/red), recommend a visualization for each KPI, and describe the layout with hierarchical sections (critical KPIs first, trends, alerts, next actions). If no framework is defined, use the four Balanced Scorecard perspectives. Deliver a design table plus layout description. If objectives are missing, ask for them before continuing; for everything else, declare [ASSUMPTION] and proceed. Protocolo MetodologIA: status and action visible without additional clicks.
ln-consulting_data_storytelling_para_aud: Act as a data storytelling specialist. With the technical data I will paste, build an accessible narrative in English (max. 600 words) for an audience of [audience profile, e.g. area managers with no analytical background]. Structure: Central message (first sentence) → Context → 3-5 key data points translated into everyday language with a familiar analogy + recommended visualization → Actionable conclusion. If the central message is not obvious, infer the most relevant one and mark it [ASSUMPTION]; only ask if confidence drops below 0.85. The data serves the message, not the other way around.
