ln-ventas_metodo_feel_felt_found: Act as a sales consultant with applied emotional intelligence. Your prospect raised an objection with emotional weight (fear, skepticism, distrust). Paste the objection and the perceived emotional context. Apply the full Feel-Felt-Found technique: (1) FEEL: validate the prospect's feeling with genuine empathy, (2) FELT: briefly narrate the case of a similar client who felt the same way, (3) FOUND: share what that client discovered upon moving forward (with a concrete result). Close with a question that invites the prospect to explore their own discovery. Deliver a table with exact text per phase + integrated script. State your assumptions first. Protocolo MetodologIA: first understand, then convince.
ln-ventas_preempt_objeciones: Act as a consultative sales strategist. You are preparing for an important presentation and want to anticipate objections before the prospect raises them. Paste the prospect profile (industry, size, title) and the solution description with approximate price. Identify the 5 most likely objections for that profile, draft the preventive message (maximum 3 sentences) for each one, and indicate the exact moment in the presentation to insert it. Deliver a 5-row table with: probable objection, preventive message, moment in the presentation, and transition phrase. State your assumptions first. Protocolo MetodologIA: anticipate to liberate, not to impose.
ln-ventas_objecion_implementacion: Act as a presales consultant with implementation experience. Your prospect fears the complexity of the implementation process. Paste their exact comment and your solution description. Draft a response of no more than 220 words that: (1) validates the concern seriously, (2) breaks the process into 3 simple phases with real timeframes, (3) shows data from similar clients, and (4) offers a minimum-friction starting route (pilot or scoped phase 1) with a date. Include a simplified 3-phase timeline. State your assumptions first. Protocolo MetodologIA: makes complexity manageable, does not hide it.
ln-ventas_objecion_no_respuesta: Act as a sales consultant specializing in deal reactivation. Your prospect has gone days without responding after a positive conversation. Paste the last message or interaction and the number of days of silence. Generate a sequence of 3 messages (maximum 300 words total) to break the silence: Message 1 today with value and an open question, Message 2 in 3-4 days with pain reframe and micro-commitment, Message 3 in 7-8 days with a soft close or break-up that leaves the door open. Include the qualification criterion for deciding whether the deal continues or moves to nurturing. State your assumptions first. Protocolo MetodologIA: deliver value in every contact, never chase without purpose.
ln-ventas_tecnica_cierre_asuncion:
Act as a senior B2B sales consultant in Latin America. The prospect's buying signals are clear. Use the assumptive close technique: draft three copy-paste-ready messages — one for a call/video call, one for email, and one for WhatsApp/Slack — that assume the decision has already been made and propose a concrete next step with a date. Assume a management SaaS product, ticket ~USD 20,000/year, prospect = operations manager, next step = signature or kick-off in 2 weeks; adjust if you paste your own context. For each message include a brief tactical note on what to do if the prospect rejects the assumption. Do not use conditional phrases like 'if you decide' or 'would you like?'.
Protocolo MetodologIA: assume the next step, declare assumptions, deliver the three copy-paste-ready messages.
ln-ventas_tecnica_cierre_alternativo:
Act as a consultative technology sales director in Latin America. I need a bank of 6 alternative-choice closing questions for a process automation platform deal: two plans (Standard and Enterprise), start dates on the 1st or 15th of next month, annual or semi-annual payment. Create 2 questions per scenario: choosing plan, choosing date, choosing payment structure. For each question indicate how to respond if they choose option A, option B, or escape with 'neither.' Add one tactical tip per scenario. No phrases like 'if you want' or 'when you're ready'; adjust if you paste your real context.
Protocolo MetodologIA: present both options as advances, declare assumptions, deliver the table ready to use in a meeting.
ln-ventas_tecnica_cierre_resumen:
Act as a senior enterprise sales consultant in Latin America. I am in the final meeting of a 3-month sales cycle with the VP of Technology. They have validated all the value but have not closed. Draft a summary-close script: 2 introduction sentences, a list of 5-7 value points confirmed in the prospect's language, a transition, and 2 closing question variants (one direct, one alternative choice). Assume a digital transformation solution + licenses; adjust if you paste your own value points. Include a note on the golden rule of silence after the question.
Protocolo MetodologIA: summarize the value confirmed by the prospect, build momentum, and close with a high-impact question.
ln-ventas_tecnica_cierre_urgencia:
Act as a sales ethics consultant and B2B consultative close coach in Latin America. I need to accelerate a deal without artificial pressure. Give me: (1) a framework of 4 legitimate urgency categories (price, capacity, regulatory/fiscal, opportunity cost) with criteria for knowing when to apply each one and when it would be manipulation; (2) 3 ready messages — verbal, email, and 3-day follow-up — using the urgency of a price increase of 8% next quarter (adjust if you have your own real urgency); (3) 5 prohibited phrases for being artificial urgency, with explanation. No ultimatums or emotional pressure.
Protocolo MetodologIA: build urgency on verifiable facts, document the legitimacy, and deliver ready-to-use messages.
ln-ventas_trial_close:
Act as a long-cycle consultative sales trainer in Latin America. I need a bank of 12 trial close probes to measure prospect readiness at 4 moments: post-demo, post-proposal, post-objection, and just before the close. For each probe indicate the ideal moment, what response indicates 'ready to close,' and what indicates 'hidden objection.' Assume enterprise management software, 60-90 day cycle, decision-maker = general manager. Without using the words 'buy' or 'hire'; all questions open-ended. Add a tactical note per moment.
Protocolo MetodologIA: measure temperature before closing, interpret signals, and scale or adjust based on the response.
ln-ventas_pedir_compromiso:
Act as a high-performance sales coach in Latin America. I need 5 direct phrases to ask for the commitment explicitly in 5 contexts: when sending the proposal, in the decision meeting with the committee, after resolving the last objection, in a post-demo follow-up with no response, and when the prospect says 'we'll think about it.' For each one: the exact phrase with the specific next step, and what to say if they respond 'I need more time.' Assume consulting services + software, ticket USD 30,000-150,000. No 'if you can' or 'whenever you're ready.' Add a mindset note on why asking for commitment is helping the prospect.
Protocolo MetodologIA: ask for commitment with clarity, explore 'more time' without pressure, and advance to the concrete next step.
ln-ventas_plan_cierre_mutuo:
Act as an enterprise sales process architect in Latin America. I need a complete Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template for a data platform implementation deal, 60-day duration to go-live, decision-makers CTO + CFO + Procurement Manager. The template must have: deal header, milestone table with owners from both parties, sections for budget approval, technical review, legal negotiation, signature and go-live, a risks section with mitigation, and usage instructions (when to present, how to co-create, review cadence). No generic owners or vague dates.
Protocolo MetodologIA: co-create the MAP with the prospect, assign concrete owners, and keep the plan alive with weekly reviews.
ln-ventas_manejo_descuento:
Act as an enterprise sales manager in Latin America with experience in price defense. I need a complete strategy for handling a discount request on an enterprise automation platform priced at USD 50,000. Give me: (1) a 3-level decision framework (don't concede / conditional concession / strategic concession) with objective criteria; (2) 4 techniques to defend the price before conceding; (3) 3 value alternatives that substitute for the price discount; (4) 2 response scripts — one verbal, one for email. No 'I can't'; use 'we can X if you do Y.' Adjust if you paste your real context.
Protocolo MetodologIA: defend the price with data, concede only with counter-consideration, and document the discount agreement.
ln-ventas_terminos_cierre:
Act as a sales operations advisor with contractual knowledge in SaaS + enterprise services deals in Latin America. I need a final contract terms negotiation guide for non-lawyer salespeople: (1) table of the 5 most frequently negotiated terms (limited liability, SLA and penalties, IP on customizations, early termination, confidentiality) with initial position, acceptable concession, and red line; (2) 3 tactics to accelerate legal negotiation; (3) email script to respond to the client's redline. Assume SaaS + implementation, USD 80,000, financial sector client. Include a note on when to escalate to legal.
Protocolo MetodologIA: negotiate from an informed position, protect red lines, and accelerate close with an agreed process.
ln-ventas_evitar_descuento_fin_mes:
Act as a B2B technology sales commercial director in Latin America. I need a guide to avoid the end-of-month discount trap. Give me: (A) 5 preventive actions with timing relative to month close (D-20, D-10, D-5, D-2, D-1) to close before the pressure arrives; (B) 4 levers alternative to a price discount if the deal reaches the last day, with a ready phrase for the prospect; (C) a 5-line script for the conversation with the manager who is pressuring me to give a discount; (D) 4 signals that the prospect is using end of month as a tactic. Assume a USD 40,000 deal with a 15% discount requested.
Protocolo MetodologIA: close by value before end of month, use levers alternative to price, and document the margin impact of each discount.
ln-ventas_recuperar_deal_estancado:
Act as a B2B pipeline optimization consultant in Latin America. I have an HR platform implementation deal (USD 35,000) that has been inactive for 45 days. I need: (1) a checklist of 6 stalling causes with a diagnostic signal; (2) a 4-step reactivation protocol; (3) 3 ready-to-use messages — a breakup email ('if this is no longer a priority...'), a new-value message, and a 90-second rescue call script; (4) 4 objective criteria for declaring the deal lost and archiving it in the CRM. Without accusing the prospect of inactivity. Adjust if you paste the real deal context.
Protocolo MetodologIA: diagnose the cause of the stall before acting, resend new value, and establish a micro-commitment to reactivate.
ln-ventas_carta_intencion:
Act as a sales operations consultant with experience in pre-contractual instruments for B2B technology deals in Latin America. I need a non-binding Letter of Intent (LOI) template for a talent management platform + implementation deal, USD 95,000, 50/50 payment at start/go-live, 30-day exclusivity, retail sector. The template must include: header, subject and scope, price and payment, timeline, commitments from both parties, exclusivity clause, non-binding clause, and signatures. Editable fields in angle brackets. Footnote: does not replace legal advice. Add usage instructions: when to propose the LOI and how to handle objections to the exclusivity.
Protocolo MetodologIA: document the verbal agreement before the formal contract is ready, lock in the budget, and protect the deal with temporary exclusivity.
ln-ventas_revision_pipeline: Act as a senior B2B sales operations consultant. Review the pipeline I will paste below: classify each opportunity with a green/yellow/red traffic light based on recent movement (green = active, yellow = no movement >14 days, red = stalled >30 days or no next step), detect the 3 main risks in the overall pipeline, propose concrete actions for the 5 most critical opportunities, and deliver a 5-line executive summary. If dates are missing, assume yellow risk. Format: pipeline table | risks | action plan | executive summary. Protocolo MetodologIA: analyze → structure → evidence → action.
ln-ventas_pronostico_forecast: Act as a senior B2B sales analyst. Using the pipeline I will paste, build the current-period forecast in three scenarios: committed (probability ≥70%), best case (≥40%), and pessimistic (only ≥90%). If deals do not have an assigned probability, use stage standards (proposal=40%, negotiation=70%, verbal close=90%). Deliver a summary table with the three totals, a breakdown by salesperson, and the list of deals in each scenario. Declare the assumptions used. Protocolo MetodologIA: extract → weight → scenarize → communicate.
ln-ventas_categorizar_forecast: Act as a B2B sales operations manager. Categorize into four forecast levels (Closed/Won, Commit, Best Case, Pipeline) each opportunity in the list I will paste. Use these criteria: Commit = prob ≥70% with a defined next step; Best Case = prob 40–69% with recent activity; Pipeline = prob <40% or no next step. If probabilities are missing, assign them by standard stage and declare them. Deliver a table with deal, value, probability, category, justification, and close date; include totals per category at the bottom. Flag deals with a past-due date or no next step. Protocolo MetodologIA: classify → justify → totalize → alert.
ln-ventas_health_score_deal: Act as a senior consultative sales coach. Evaluate the opportunity I will describe using 5 dimensions of 20 points each: identified need, access to decision-maker, differentiated value proposition, clear buying process, and relationship/engagement. If information is missing for a dimension, score it 5/20 and flag it. Deliver: a scoring table, total score (0–100) with a verdict (critical/at risk/healthy/strong), a diagnosis of the 2 priority weaknesses, and a plan of 3 concrete actions with a deadline. Protocolo MetodologIA: evaluate → score → diagnose → act.
ln-ventas_priorizar_oportunidades_pipeli: Act as a B2B sales director. Prioritize the pipeline I will paste using a composite index: (Value × Probability) / Effort, where effort is high=3, medium=2, low=1 if not quantified. Sort the deals from highest to lowest index, classify them into high (top 20%), medium (20–60%), and low priority (60–100%), write a one-line recommendation per high-priority deal, and identify deals that are candidates to pause or close. Deliver a sorted table with rank, index, priority, and recommendation. Protocolo MetodologIA: calculate → rank → classify → decide.
ln-ventas_analisis_velocidad: Act as a senior sales operations analyst. Analyze the pipeline data I will paste to calculate the average time spent at each stage and the conversion rate between stages. Identify the 2–3 main bottlenecks (slowest stages or highest conversion drop), compare them with the standard B2B benchmark (discovery ≤7d, proposal ≤14d, negotiation ≤21d, close ≤7d), and deliver 2 concrete recommendations per bottleneck. If there are outliers, use the median. Protocolo MetodologIA: measure → compare → diagnose → optimize.
ln-ventas_deal_review: Act as a senior B2B sales director specializing in high-value deals. Using the deal information I will paste, produce a complete deal review: (1) 5-line situation summary, (2) stakeholder map with role and position (champion/neutral/blocker), (3) analysis of the 3–5 most critical risks with their mitigation, (4) recommended closing strategy, and (5) next 3 steps with owner and date. If the final decision-maker is missing, flag it as an immediate critical risk. Protocolo MetodologIA: diagnose → map → strategy → act.
ln-ventas_higiene_crm: Act as a senior CRM administrator and sales operations professional. Review the CRM export or description I will paste: identify the most frequent error types (empty fields, duplicates, invalid values, outdated records), quantify them, generate a minimum-field checklist per object (opportunity, contact, account) with its current status, and deliver a prioritized correction plan with owner and deadline. Close with 2–3 validation rules to prevent recurrence. Protocolo MetodologIA: audit → classify → prioritize → prevent.
ln-ventas_limpiar_pipeline: Act as a B2B sales operations director. Clean the pipeline I will paste below: identify zombie deals (no activity >30 days), deals to pause (prob <20% without a next step), and deals to reactivate (recent activity but no next step). Classify each purgeable deal as close/lose, pause, or reactivate with a concrete action. Calculate the real pipeline after the purge. Close with 3 practices to keep the pipeline clean. If a zombie deal is in the top 10% by value, escalate it to the manager before flagging it. Protocolo MetodologIA: diagnose → purge → recalculate → prevent.
ln-ventas_analisis_perdidas: Act as a senior sales and commercial strategy analyst. Analyze the list of lost deals I will paste below: classify each loss reason into standard categories (price, competition, product fit, timing, customer process, relationship, inadequate proposal), calculate the frequency and value lost per category, build a Pareto of causes, distinguish internal from external causes, and deliver an improvement plan with 3–5 actions prioritized by impact. If a competitor appears recurrently, add a competitive analysis section. Protocolo MetodologIA: classify → quantify → diagnose → improve.
ln-ventas_plan_cobertura_cuota: Act as a B2B sales director. Calculate the quota coverage ratio using the pipeline and quota I will give you: ratio = weighted pipeline (value × probability) / target quota. Determine the scenario (sufficient coverage ≥3x, moderate deficit 1.5x–2.9x, critical deficit <1.5x), quantify the gap, and deliver a scenario-specific action plan: for moderate deficit, identify accelerable deals; for critical deficit, add new pipeline generation actions. Alert if the pipeline is concentrated in few deals. Protocolo MetodologIA: calculate → diagnose → plan → execute.
ln-ventas_plan_territorio: Act as a B2B regional sales director. With the territory information I will give you, design a territory plan: segment accounts into A (high potential), B (medium potential), and C (low potential), calculate the total territory potential, and compare it to the assigned quota. Define the attack strategy (new accounts) and the defense strategy (retention and expansion of current accounts). Close with a quarterly calendar of key activities with monthly milestones. If the potential is below the quota, alert about over-assignment. Protocolo MetodologIA: segment → prioritize → strategy → schedule.
ln-ventas_plan_cuenta_estrategica:
Act as a key accounts director with 15 years in B2B consultative sales. With the account information I will paste below (CRM, history, contacts), prepare a Strategic Account Plan for the next 12 months. Include: executive summary, account profile, stakeholder map (champion/decision-maker/user/blocker), 3–5 opportunities prioritized by potential revenue, annual SMART objectives, quarterly action plan with owner and deliverable, and 5 tracking KPIs. If a key piece of data is missing, declare a reasonable assumption and continue. The result must be presentable to the commercial director without additional editing. Tag each inference with [INFERENCE] and each assumption with [ASSUMPTION].

Protocolo MetodologIA · Mandatory evidence on every key claim.
ln-ventas_qbr_cliente:
Act as a senior Customer Success Manager specializing in executive quarterly reviews. With the quarter data I will paste below, prepare the complete QBR script for a 75-minute meeting with the client. Include: agenda with time blocks, value narrative linking achievements to the client's objectives, metrics table with status and gaps, analysis of 2-3 critical gaps with root cause, improvement plan for the next quarter, and a next-steps section with mutual commitments. If there are serious incidents, open with them honestly before the achievements. Tag each real metric with [DATA] and each assumption with [ASSUMPTION].

Protocolo MetodologIA · Honest narrative; tagged evidence.
ln-ventas_plan_expansion_cuenta:
Act as a strategic accounts executive with experience in B2B expansion of corporate contracts. With the client information I will paste below (active contracts, buying areas, known contacts), build an Account Expansion Plan for 18 months. Include: current position table, whitespace map crossing our own portfolio with the client's structure, 3-5 opportunities prioritized by revenue potential and ease of access, strategy to access new stakeholders, quarterly action plan, and 4 expansion KPIs. If any data is missing, declare the assumption and continue. Tag each opportunity according to its source: [DATA], [INFERENCE], or [ASSUMPTION].

Protocolo MetodologIA · Sequential expansion; tagged evidence on each opportunity.
ln-ventas_upsell_estrategia:
Act as a commercial growth specialist with experience in upsell for SaaS products and enterprise subscription services. With the client information I will paste below (current tier, usage data, recent interactions), design a complete Upsell Strategy. Include: upsell readiness signals identified in the data, value proposition of the higher tier expressed in the client's business terms, ideal customer profile for upsell, 5-step conversation sequence, two opening messages (email and meeting), and criteria to pause the upsell. Tag real signals with [DATA] and inferred ones with [INFERENCE].

Protocolo MetodologIA · Value before product; tagged evidence on each signal.
ln-ventas_cross_sell_estrategia:
Act as a portfolio sales manager with experience in cross-sell for catalogs of technology solutions or professional services. With the information I will paste below (available portfolio, client profile, products already purchased), design a Cross-Sell Strategy. Include: affinity table between the client's products and those not acquired, 2-3 combinations prioritized by complementarity and revenue potential, the right stakeholder for each combination, value narrative (client's problem first, never a feature catalog), approach sequence, and two ready-to-use opening messages. Tag affinities with [INFERENCE] or [DATA] according to their source.

Protocolo MetodologIA · Client context before product catalog; tagged evidence.
ln-ventas_plan_renovacion:
Act as a specialist in enterprise contract retention and renewal. With the contract and client relationship information I will paste below, prepare a Contract Renewal Plan for the next 90 days. Include: diagnosis of the relationship state (green/yellow/red), risk factors and retention levers, accumulated value argument with data from the contract period, negotiation strategy with initial position and acceptable concessions, week-by-week action sequence, and contingency plan if the client declines. Tag real data with [DATA], inferences with [INFERENCE], and assumptions with [ASSUMPTION].

Protocolo MetodologIA · Immediately executable sequence; accumulated value as the negotiation anchor.
ln-ventas_prevenir_churn: Act as a senior Customer Success Manager specializing in B2B retention. Based on the customer information I will paste below, identify churn risk signals (critical, moderate, latent), diagnose the probable root cause, and build a week-by-week 30-day retention plan with concrete actions, owners, and success metrics. Include three re-engagement message templates (executive, technical, and relational tone) ready to send. If the contract renews in fewer than 90 days, add escalation criteria. Assume an annual contract and a champion with reduced internal visibility; if you need more context, ask only for sector and contracted product. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start, proceed without additional questions if confidence ≥ 0.85.
ln-ventas_white_space_cuenta: Act as a senior account strategist specializing in enterprise account expansion. With the information I share about the account and the available portfolio, build a white space map: a matrix that crosses the customer's business units with the products and services in the portfolio, classifying each cell as active, in conversation, identified potential, unknown, or not applicable. Calculate an opportunity score for each cell and prioritize the top 5 with justification and a concrete next step. Assume a portfolio of 5–15 products and 3–10 business units; if you need minimum data, ask only for the product list and known BUs. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start, proceed without questions if confidence ≥ 0.85.
ln-ventas_land_and_expand: Act as an enterprise sales director expert in land-and-expand strategies for high-potential B2B accounts. With the customer and first-contract information I share, design a complete strategy that includes: (1) definition of the optimal entry point with measurable success criteria, (2) quick wins executable in the first 60–90 days to build internal credibility, (3) expansion routes prioritized by ease and impact (horizontal and vertical), (4) a 12-month roadmap with quarterly milestones and expansion conversation triggers, and (5) actions to enable the internal champion as a promoter. Assume an initial contract of 3–12 months and a customer with at least 3 additional BUs. Declare assumptions at the start. Protocolo MetodologIA: proceed without questions if confidence ≥ 0.85.
ln-ventas_caso_exito_cliente: Act as a specialist in B2B success story writing for executive and technical audiences. With the customer information and results I share, write a complete success story in two versions: a 3-paragraph executive summary and an extended version of 600–900 words. Include: context of the prior challenge, description of the implemented solution, measurable results with before/after comparison, a customer quote (marked as proposed if not verbatim), and a bullet-point fact sheet. If any metric is unconfirmed, mark it as [ASSUMPTION – validate with customer]. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start, flag everything that requires validation.
ln-ventas_solicitar_testimonio: Act as a senior customer success manager specializing in B2B advocacy programs. With the customer information and results I share, generate: (1) an initial message to request a testimonial or reference (warm, pressure-free, with a clear benefit for the customer), (2) a follow-up for 7 days later if there is no response, (3) three pre-written testimonial templates in the customer's voice (short, medium, and long) ready for the customer to simply approve or minimally adjust, and (4) a briefing template if the customer will give an active reference to a prospect. Also include a quick guide if the customer wants to record a video. Declare assumptions at the start. Protocolo MetodologIA: proceed without additional questions if confidence ≥ 0.85.
ln-ventas_estrategia_negociacion: Act as a senior commercial negotiator specializing in B2B enterprise sales. With the deal and customer information I share, design a complete negotiation strategy that includes: (1) an opening position justified by value, (2) a table of negotiable variables with movement ranges, (3) a planned concession sequence indicating what to concede first and what to never concede, (4) prepared responses to the 3 most probable objections, (5) closing tactic and signals, and (6) a contingency plan in case of impasse or unplanned discount. Assume negotiation on price, timeline, and scope with at least two decision-makers on the customer side. Declare assumptions at the start. Protocolo MetodologIA: proceed if confidence ≥ 0.85.
ln-ventas_definir_batna: Act as a senior sales negotiator trained in principled negotiation. With the deal information and context I share, build a BATNA and negotiation limits sheet that includes: (1) the seller's real BATNA documented and evaluated, (2) the minimum acceptable reservation point (reservation value) with financial justification, (3) a limits table classified as red (never cross), yellow (cross only with compensation), and green (free maneuvering space), (4) an estimate of the customer's probable BATNA to calibrate relative power, and (5) reframing messages for when the negotiation reaches a critical limit. Declare assumptions about customer alternatives. Protocolo MetodologIA: proceed if confidence ≥ 0.85, ask only if the deal value or available alternatives data is missing.
ln-ventas_anclaje_precio: Act as a senior commercial negotiator specializing in price psychology and cognitive anchoring in B2B sales. With the deal information and negotiation context I share, design the complete price anchoring tactic: (1) decide whether to anchor first or let the customer do so, justifying the decision, (2) formulate the initial anchor with explicit value framing and market comparatives, (3) build the total value argument (TCO, ROI, risk of alternatives) to accompany the price presentation, (4) prepare the response to price shock or an aggressive counteroffer without automatically conceding, and (5) plan the anchor adjustment moves toward the final objective. Declare assumptions about the customer's market information. Protocolo MetodologIA: proceed if confidence ≥ 0.85.
ln-ventas_intercambio_concesiones: Act as a senior sales negotiator specializing in strategic concession management in complex B2B negotiations. With the deal information and negotiation history I share, build the concession exchange plan: (1) a table of all available concessions classified by real cost to the seller and perceived value to the customer, (2) optimal delivery sequence prioritizing those with the greatest asymmetry (low cost, high perceived value), (3) ready-to-use linking phrases to communicate each concession conditioned on a counterpart, and (4) a clear stopping-point criterion with a closing message without rupture. Assume at least 4 negotiable variables beyond price. Declare assumptions about perceived customer value. Protocolo MetodologIA: proceed without additional questions if confidence ≥ 0.85.
ln-ventas_manejo_compras: Act as a senior sales negotiator specializing in corporate procurement processes. My deal is being reviewed by the customer's purchasing department and I need to navigate this process without losing the price and conditions I agreed with the champion. With the context I share, design the complete strategy: (1) diagnosis of procurement's real motivations and what they need to report as a win, (2) low-real-cost concessions that procurement can present as achievements without affecting margin, (3) clear position on the contractual terms they will probably reject, (4) champion activation plan as an ally during the process, and (5) responses to classic purchasing tactics (time pressure, competitor offer, final price, last-minute tender). Declare assumptions at the start. Protocolo MetodologIA: proceed if confidence ≥ 0.85.
ln-ventas_negociacion_multipartita: Act as a senior enterprise sales strategist specializing in complex deals with buying committees. Using the stakeholder information and deal context I share with you, design the complete multiparty negotiation strategy: (1) a power and influence map for each stakeholder showing their current position and primary motivator, (2) a personalized value proposition and argument per profile in their own language, (3) a conversation-sequence plan indicating who to see first and what to ask each champion, (4) a blocker-management plan, and (5) a strategy for the joint committee meeting with a facilitation script. Assume between 3 and 6 active stakeholders. Declare assumptions about influence and position when direct data is unavailable. Protocolo MetodologIA: proceed if confidence ≥ 0.85.
ln-ventas_proteger_margen: Act as a senior commercial director specializing in margin defense under pressure in high-value B2B sales. The client is pushing hard for a price reduction. Using the negotiation context I share with you, design the complete arsenal to protect the margin: (1) a diagnosis of the type of pressure the client is applying (tactical, budgetary, comparative, or perceived-value), (2) specific responses to the 4 most common tactics (last-minute discount, cheaper competitor, fixed budget, closing urgency), (3) differential value arguments that make comparing prices alone unfair, (4) an internal escalation protocol if the pressure exceeds my authority, and (5) the firm message that preserves the relationship. Declare assumptions at the start. Protocolo MetodologIA: proceed if confidence ≥ 0.85.
ln-ventas_correo_seguimiento_reunion:
Act as a senior B2B sales consultant. Using the meeting notes I paste below, draft a professional follow-up email: a compelling subject, a 3-bullet summary, confirmation of commitments from both parties, one sentence reinforcing the value proposition, and a CTA with a specific date (if none exists, propose 5 business days). Professional-warm tone, maximum 250 words in the body. Deliver [SUBJECT] and [BODY] ready to copy-paste. Declare any assumptions you use.

Protocolo MetodologIA: confirm key assumptions before delivering.
ln-ventas_secuencia_nurturing:
Act as a B2B nurturing specialist for long sales cycles. The lead I will describe responded 'it's not the right time.' Design a sequence of 5-6 spaced emails (day 0, 7, 14, 30, 45, 60 by default) that progressively educate, demonstrate real value, and prepare for the commercial reopening. Each email: subject + body ≤150 words + soft CTA. Deliver a cadence table + numbered emails ready to load into a sequencer. Declare any assumptions. Paste the lead profile below.

Protocolo MetodologIA: educational arc first, pitch at the end.
ln-vibe-coding_brief-de-app-en-una-frase:
Act as a senior product manager specializing in rapid AI-driven launches. Take the app idea sentence I am about to paste and convert it into a one-page executable brief: target user, core problem, proposed solution, 3-5 core features, platform, technical constraints, and MVP success criterion. Declare the assumptions you use. At the end, add 3 validation questions I should answer before coding. Markdown format with numbered sections.

Protocolo MetodologIA: minimum viable context for maximum code launch.

I have my cycle Objectives (paste them below; if you don't paste them, invent 2 typical B2B product team objectives). For each Objective produce 2–4 Key Results with structure: [Metric] from [baseline] to [target] by end of quarter. Requirements: outcome-oriented (not activity or task), measurable, verifiable by third parties, ambitious but with a 60–70% achievement confidence. Deliver a table: Objective / Key Result / Type (output or outcome) / Measurement formula / Assumed baseline / Target. Declare assumptions in ≤4 lines at the end. Protocolo MetodologIA: classify each KR as output or outcome and rewrite any KR that is a task.
ln-liderazgo_okr_cascada_alineacion: Act as a senior consultant in multilevel OKR deployment. I have the corporate and team OKRs (paste them below; if you don't paste them, use these assumptions: 3 corporate objectives —revenue growth, customer experience, operational efficiency— and 2 teams with 2 objectives each). Produce: (1) cascade tree in structured text showing the contribution chain, (2) table of horizontal dependencies between teams with the associated risk, (3) list of coverage gaps with high/medium/low severity. Mark orphan OKRs. Declare assumptions in ≤4 lines. Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that each team OKR has at least one traceable link before delivering the map.
ln-liderazgo_okr_check_in_semanal: Act as an Agile Coach specializing in OKR check-ins. My team of 8 people has 3 objectives with 3 KRs each and needs a facilitation guide for a 30-minute weekly check-in focused on achievement confidence, not activities. Design: (a) agenda with exact times, (b) powerful questions per segment, (c) capture template with columns confidence / trend / risk / action / owner / deadline. Include warning signals for the facilitator and the escalation protocol if a KR is red for two consecutive weeks. Declare assumptions in ≤3 lines. Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the design produces at least one adjustment decision per session and does not allow the conversation to drift to activity reporting.
ln-liderazgo_okr_scoring_cierre_trimestr: Act as an OKR cycle-close coach. I have the final results for my quarter (paste them below; if you don't paste them, use assumptions: 2 objectives with 3 KRs each, mixed scores of 100%, 70%, and 40% per objective). Use the Google 0.0–1.0 scale (0.7 = expected success). Produce: (a) scoring table with traffic-light color and root cause for red/yellow KRs; (b) qualitative evaluation of each Objective; (c) 3 actionable learnings in standardized format; (d) continue/adjust/retire recommendations per KR. Declare assumptions in ≤3 lines. Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that root causes are specific and learnings have a concrete action before delivering.
ln-liderazgo_okr_diferenciar_metricas_sa: Act as a consultant in OKR measurement system design. I have a list of metrics from my team (paste them below; if you don't paste them, use these 8 typical technology indicators: service uptime, NPS, delivery speed, eNPS, defect rate, support response time, customer retention, test coverage). Classify each one as OKR or Health Metric using the health test and the OKR test. Produce: (a) classification table with justification and minimum threshold for health metrics; (b) list of KR candidates with aspiration level; (c) health board recommendation with cadence. Declare assumptions in ≤3 lines. Protocolo MetodologIA: warn if the team has overcommitment risk from mixing both types.
ln-liderazgo_okr_aspiracional_vs_comprom: Act as an expert in OKR portfolio calibration. I have my team's OKRs for this cycle (paste them below; if you don't paste them, use these 4 assumptions: consolidate current platform, triple active integrations, maintain uptime >99.9%, launch freemium model). Classify each one as aspirational (moonshot, confidence 60–70%) or committed (roofshot, confidence >90%), calibrate targets that are not aligned with the type, and deliver the differentiated scoring expectations guide. Table: OKR / Current type / Recommended type / Original target / Calibrated target / Justification. Declare assumptions in ≤3 lines. Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the final distribution is not 100% committed nor 100% aspirational.
ln-liderazgo_okr_taller_facilitacion: Act as an expert facilitator for OKR definition workshops. I need the complete design for a 3-hour virtual workshop for 12 people in Miro. The workshop must produce 3–5 qualitative Objectives approved by the team and at least 2 KRs per Objective, with active participation from everyone. Design: (a) detailed agenda with times and objective for each phase; (b) facilitation guide with precise instructions; (c) digital templates for participants; (d) OKR quality criteria for real-time validation; (e) techniques for managing dominant participants. Strategic context available: [paste here or leave blank]. Declare assumptions in ≤3 lines. Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the design guarantees participation from everyone before delivering.
ln-liderazgo_okr_antipatrones_diagnostic: Act as a senior consultant in OKR implementation diagnosis. I have my team's OKRs and follow-up process (paste them below; if you paste nothing, use the most common anti-patterns: objectives as task lists, KRs without baseline, omitted check-ins, scores always at 100%, strategic disconnection). Identify the present anti-patterns, explain the damage each one causes, and produce a prioritized remediation plan. Table: Anti-pattern / Evidence / Damage / Priority. For high-priority ones, show the original OKR and the corrected version. Remediation plan in 3 steps. Declare assumptions in ≤3 lines. Protocolo MetodologIA: flag if any anti-pattern requires intervention at higher leadership levels.
ln-liderazgo_okr_smart_individual: Act as a senior consultant in performance management. I have my team's OKRs and my collaborators' roles (paste them below; if you paste nothing, use 3 roles: Senior Developer, UX Designer, and Data Analyst, with team OKRs: improve customer retention, accelerate delivery speed, and strengthen code quality). For each role formulate 3–5 individual SMART goals that explicitly contribute to the team's OKRs. Table per collaborator: Goal / SMART criterion (✓/✗ per dimension) / Contribution to OKR / Challenge level / Evidence source. Include at least 1 stretch goal per person. Period: semi-annual. Declare assumptions in ≤3 lines. Protocolo MetodologIA: verify the 5 SMART criteria before delivering each goal.
ln-liderazgo_okr_comunicar_a_equipo: Act as a strategic communicator and leadership coach. I have the quarter's OKRs and need to communicate them to the team in a way that generates understanding and ownership, not just information (paste the OKRs below; if you don't paste them, use assumptions: 3 digital product objectives — become the customer experience benchmark, cut delivery time in half, consolidate a measurable learning culture). Channel: 45-min live session + Slack summary message. Produce: (a) opening message ≤300 words for Slack; (b) narrative guide for live session (≤2 min per objective); (c) anticipated FAQs with answers; (d) 2–3 opening questions for the session. Declare assumptions in ≤3 lines. Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the narrative for each OKR explains the impact, not just the target.
ln-liderazgo_okr_priorizacion_foco:
I have a list of candidate objectives for the next OKR cycle (paste them here). Act as an experienced OKR coach: score each objective on strategic impact, urgency, and actual team capacity (1-5 each), select the 3-5 with the highest total score, discard the rest to the backlog with a brief justification, draft each chosen OKR as an inspiring Objective + 2-3 Key Results with metric and date, and close with a focus narrative of max. 100 words to communicate the decision to the team. Default horizon: quarter. Declare any assumptions you make.

Protocolo MetodologIA: show the scoring rationale before delivering the final OKRs.
ln-liderazgo_contratacion_perfil_rol:
I need to define the profile of a role I am going to hire for (describe the position and the need here). Act as a role design specialist: (1) formulate the purpose of the position in one impact sentence, (2) list 5-7 key responsibilities by priority, (3) separate must-have from nice-to-have competencies, (4) define 3 success indicators at 30, 60, and 90 days, and (5) build a scorecard with competencies, observable criteria, and a 1-4 scale. Assumed level: senior individual contributor in a technology company. Declare any assumptions.

Protocolo MetodologIA: start by identifying the business problem that originates the vacancy.
ln-liderazgo_contratacion_jd_inclusiva:
I have the role profile I want to hire for (paste it here). Draft an inclusive job description ready to publish: (1) detect and correct exclusionary or gender-biased language showing a change table, (2) write a header with an impact phrase, a paragraph on the role's purpose, 5-7 bullets of active responsibilities, requirements divided into essential (≤5) vs. nice-to-have, a culture/benefits section without clichés, and a D&I declaration with concrete actions. Sector: technology, modality: hybrid by default. Declare assumptions.

Protocolo MetodologIA: show the language correction table first.
ln-liderazgo_contratacion_guia_entrevist:
I need a competency-based structured interview guide for the following role (paste the profile or list of competencies). Extract 4-5 critical competencies, define each one operationally, draft 3-4 STAR behavioral questions per competency with 2 follow-up probes, design a 1-4 evaluation rubric with behavioral descriptors, and write the session opening and closing script plus brief instructions for interviewers. Interview duration: 60 minutes, team of 2 interviewers by default.

Protocolo MetodologIA: justify the selected competencies before drafting the questions.
ln-liderazgo_contratacion_entrevista_val:
I need a guide for the values and culture-add interview of a candidate (share the team's values and the role here). Translate each value into observable behaviors, draft 2 behavioral questions + 1 dilemma question per value, add 3 culture-add questions aimed at bringing in different perspectives, write 5 anti-bias instructions for the interviewer, and design a dual-axis rubric: values alignment 1-4 and cultural contribution 1-4. Max. 45 minutes of interview.

Protocolo MetodologIA: define observable behaviors before drafting questions.
ln-liderazgo_contratacion_debrief_panel:
My team just finished interviewing a candidate and we need to conduct the panel debrief in a structured way (paste the scorecards or evaluation summary). Facilitate the process with: a 30-45 minute agenda, a silent independent voting protocol before discussion, an evidence consolidation template per competency, a disagreement handling process, decision criteria (hire / do not hire / second interview), and a record template with justification. Team of 3 interviewers by default.

Protocolo MetodologIA: silent voting always precedes group discussion.
ln-liderazgo_contratacion_referencias:
I am going to call the references of a finalist candidate for the following role (describe the position and the areas where I need clarity). Design a reference verification guide with: a 60-second opening script to build trust, revealing questions by category (performance, team, integrity, reason for leaving), 2 maximum-disclosure closing questions, 8-10 warning signals to listen for, and a real-time record template. Target duration: 20 minutes. Two references by default (manager + peer).

Protocolo MetodologIA: distinguish diplomatic responses from concrete behavioral evidence.
ln-liderazgo_contratacion_oferta_cierre:
I have the offer ready for the selected candidate and I need to prepare the closing conversation (share the offer details and any reservation the candidate expressed). Design a script with: a genuine and personalized opening, presentation of the offer in order of perceived value, handling of 4-5 common objections with responses that explore rather than defend, 2-3 soft closing techniques, and a follow-up protocol if they ask for time (deadline, intermediate touch, withdrawal criterion). Senior candidate in technology by default.

Protocolo MetodologIA: explore the candidate's motivation before presenting the offer.
ln-liderazgo_contratacion_plan_30_60_90:
I am going to bring a new person onto the team and I need to design their onboarding plan (share the role profile and main responsibilities). Design a 30-60-90 day plan with: the objective of each horizon in one sentence, week-by-week activities in the first month and bi-weekly in the following two, 3 measurable success indicators per horizon, calibration meetings with a standard agenda (day 15, 30, 60, 90), resources and accesses per stage, and 5-7 key conversations with a specific objective. Senior role, hybrid modality by default.

Protocolo MetodologIA: define the objective of each horizon before designing the activities.
ln-liderazgo_contratacion_preboarding:
I signed the offer with a new team member and I want to design a preboarding sequence for the weeks before their first day (share name, position, and start date). Design: a touchpoint timeline from signing to the day before, warm and specific model messages for each moment, a checklist of internal logistical tasks (access, equipment, agenda), the buddy's role in preboarding, and a phased content kit (what information to share when). Assume 3 weeks of preboarding, hybrid modality.

Protocolo MetodologIA: design from the perspective of the new team member, not from the administrative perspective.
ln-liderazgo_contratacion_buddy_system:
I want to formalize a buddy system for new additions to my team (describe the team and the typical profile of new hires). Design the complete system: criteria for selecting and assigning the buddy, role description with clear boundaries, week-by-week accompaniment schedule during the first 4 weeks, 4-5 key conversation templates, escalation protocol to the leader, and a concrete recognition mechanism for buddies. Team of 8-20 people, hybrid mode by default.

Protocolo MetodologIA: clearly define the boundaries of the buddy role vs. the leader role.
ln-liderazgo_contratacion_check_in_90_di:
The 90-day check-in for one of my new team members is coming up and I want to do it well (share the agreed indicators and your performance observations). Design: a pre-session preparation checklist for the leader, a 60-minute session agenda with time allocations, 4-5 evidence-based performance evaluation questions, 4-5 active-listening questions about their integration experience, decision criteria for confirmation/extension/termination, and a closing agreement template. Senior individual contributor role by default.

Protocolo MetodologIA: design genuine space for the new team member's voice; minimum 40% of session time.
ln-liderazgo_contratacion_marca_empleado: Act as a senior employer branding consultant specializing in technology teams. Based on the team description I will paste (or with declared assumptions if I do not include it), draft: (1) a 3-sentence EVP that captures the team's real differentiator, (2) a team description of 150-200 words for job postings, free of corporate clichés, (3) three short LinkedIn posts of maximum 280 characters each with an emotional hook and CTA, and (4) three culture interview questions that reveal genuine alignment with the team's values. If I do not specify the industry, assume B2B software; if I do not describe the culture, assume autonomy, high performance, and continuous learning. Deliver all four sections labeled and ready to use. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare your assumptions at the start, use only information from the input, and label each section clearly.
ln-liderazgo_delegacion_niveles_autorida: Act as an executive coach specializing in structured delegation. Based on the responsibility or area you describe to me (or with declared assumptions if I do not detail it), build a delegation matrix with five explicit authority levels: inform, recommend, decide with consultation, decide with notification, and decide autonomously. Assign each key activity to the corresponding level with a brief justification. Then draft a 5-minute conversation guide to communicate the matrix to the team member, with concrete phrases. If I do not indicate the team member's experience level, assume 2-4 years. Deliver the table in markdown format and the conversation guide ready for a 1:1. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start, justify each level assignment, and use literal phrases in the guide.
ln-liderazgo_delegacion_matriz_eisenhowe: Act as an executive productivity strategist. Take the list of tasks and responsibilities I will paste and apply the Eisenhower matrix to classify each one in the four quadrants: urgent+important, urgent+not important, not urgent+important, not urgent+not important. For each task, assign a concrete action: delegate (indicating the suggested profile), eliminate, schedule, or retain with justification. Then build an immediate delegation plan for urgent but not important tasks. If I do not give you the available team, assume five people with generalist roles. Deliver everything in a markdown table and the delegation plan at the end. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start, justify each classification in one sentence, and deliver only actionable artifacts.
ln-liderazgo_delegacion_brief_resultado: Act as a senior consultant in delegation systems design. Write a result-oriented delegation brief for the task or project you describe to me. The brief must have seven sections: context and purpose, expected result with measurable criteria, scope (with explicit exclusions), resources and constraints, three follow-up milestones with dates, assigned authority level, and escalation protocol. The team member must be able to start work by reading only the brief, without an additional meeting. If I do not indicate the duration, assume two weeks. Deliver the structured document ready to share. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start, use result-oriented language in each section.
ln-liderazgo_delegacion_monkey_managemen: Act as an executive coach specializing in team autonomy development. Design a system so that I, as a leader, stop receiving problems without a proposed solution from my team members. The system must include: (1) a conversation protocol with concrete phrases to return the problem to whoever brought it, adapted to three typical situations, (2) the next-move rule requiring the team member to arrive with at least two options, (3) a table for tracking assigned problems, and (4) a 1-page guide to communicate this dynamic change to the team. If you do not have team context, assume technology sector, five team members, and high dependency. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start, use literal phrases, distinguish genuine emergencies from dependency.
ln-liderazgo_delegacion_seguimiento_sin_: Act as a specialist in performance management systems and high-autonomy leadership. Design a follow-up system for my active delegations that keeps me informed without generating micromanagement. The system must include: (1) a contact-point cadence differentiated by the work's risk and the team member's maturity, (2) three high-value questions for each contact point that generate information without sounding like an interrogation, (3) a status update format that the team member fills out autonomously with a maximum of five fields, (4) five early warning signals with the recommended response for each one. If you do not have context, assume five active delegations and medium confidence level. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start, design for autonomy by default, and deliver implementable artifacts this week.
ln-liderazgo_delegacion_liderazgo_situac: Act as an executive coach certified in situational leadership. Based on the team member description and task you give me, evaluate the development level (D1-D4 by Blanchard) with two justified indicators, assign the corresponding leadership style (E1-E4) with concrete behaviors, and draft three conversation opening phrases for that style. Then build the complete transition table showing when and how to move from one style to the next. If you do not give me context about the team member or the task, assume a new team member on a complex technical task. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start, justify the diagnosis with observable indicators, and use literal phrases.
ln-liderazgo_delegacion_empoderar_decisi: Act as a senior consultant in organizational design and team empowerment. Create a documented decision perimeter for my team with three categories: autonomous decisions, decisions with advance notification to the leader before acting, and decisions reserved for the leader. Include at least five examples per category adapted to the team context, an update protocol for the perimeter, and the agenda for a 30-minute session to present and validate it with the team. If you do not have context, assume a technology team of six people with technical, process, and stakeholder communication decisions. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start, use context-specific examples, and deliver ready-to-present artifacts.
ln-liderazgo_delegacion_stretch_assignme: Act as an expert in accelerated talent development. Design a complete stretch assignment for the collaborator you describe to me. Include: (1) diagnosis of the development gap the assignment closes, (2) description of the assignment with scope, expected outcome, and duration, (3) leader support plan with check-ins and support network, (4) dual success criteria (what the collaborator delivers + what they learn), (5) contingency plan for two blocking scenarios. If you give me no context about the collaborator, assume a professional with 3–5 years of experience with leadership potential and a three-month duration. Deliver the document in five sections ready to present in a 1:1. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start, design for real growth, deliver an actionable artifact.
ln-liderazgo_delegacion_documentar_trasp: Act as a senior consultant in knowledge management and operational continuity. Create a complete responsibility handover document for the transfer you describe. The document must have seven sections: description and purpose of the responsibility, current status (in progress/pending/blocked), historical context with key decisions and lessons, stakeholder map, active risks and pending commitments with dates, recommended accompaniment period, and a verification checklist confirming the receiver is ready. If you do not describe the responsibility, assume management of a software project with two weeks of available overlap. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start, document with focus on the receiver, and deliver a shareable artifact.
ln-liderazgo_delegacion_recuperar_delega: Act as an executive coach specializing in difficult conversation management and project recovery. A delegation I made is not working and I need a recovery plan. Tell me: (1) three root-cause hypotheses with diagnostic questions, (2) recovery conversation script in three parts (acknowledge, redirect, agree) with literal phrases, (3) adjusted re-delegation plan with what changes and why, (4) emergency escalation protocol if the deadline is critical, (5) three prevention actions for the next delegation. If you give me no context, assume a technical project with a deadline in two weeks and a relationship of trust at risk. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start, produce literal phrases, and distinguish whether the failure comes from the leader or the collaborator.
ln-liderazgo_conflicto_diagnostico_fuent: Act as a senior specialist in organizational conflict resolution and team dynamics. Based on the conflict description you give me, diagnose the source using a five-category framework with observable indicators, propose a primary and secondary source hypothesis based on evidence, design a diagnostic interview plan with three neutral questions per party involved, build a decision tree to choose the type of intervention, and issue an initial recommendation with justification. If you give me no context about the conflict, assume a conflict between two collaborators over role overlap. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start, base hypotheses on evidence from the input, and deliver literal and neutral interview questions.
ln-liderazgo_conflicto_mediacion_dos_per:
Act as a senior consultant in organizational conflict management. I have two collaborators in conflict that is damaging the team climate and results. Design a complete one-page mediation plan: include a guide for prior individual interviews (5 questions per person), agenda for the joint session (maximum 90 minutes), post-mediation agreement template with 2-week follow-up, and criteria to escalate to HR if it fails. Assume the conflict is over overlapping responsibilities unless I indicate otherwise, declare that assumption, and proceed. The deliverable must be executable by me without external help.

Protocolo MetodologIA: apply systemic listening, facilitative neutrality, and verifiable behavioral agreements.
ln-liderazgo_conflicto_estilos_thomas_ki:
Act as an executive coach expert in the Thomas-Kilmann conflict management model. Analyze the conflict I am going to describe to you and recommend which of the five styles (compete, collaborate, compromise, avoid, accommodate) I should use. Discard the other four with one concrete reason each. Then give me a 3–5 sentence opening script I can use exactly as written in the conversation. If the conflict involves parties of equal hierarchy discussing priorities, that is your default assumption; if it is different, I will tell you. Include the most important risk warning for the style you recommend.

Protocolo MetodologIA: rigorous situational mapping with the Thomas-Kilmann model and a ready-to-use opening script.
ln-liderazgo_conflicto_desactivar_tensio:
Act as an expert facilitator in group dynamics and emotional de-escalation. I need a three-phase intervention protocol to defuse a heated discussion happening right now in a team meeting. Give me literal phrases in neutral Spanish that I can read directly from my phone: first to pause the dynamic in the first 30 seconds, then to redirect the energy toward the common goal, and finally to restore collaboration with a concrete next step. Include an adjustment note if the meeting is virtual. If I have no specific context, assume a technology sprint review and declare that assumption.

Protocolo MetodologIA: three-phase intervention with literal phrases in neutral Spanish ready for an ongoing meeting.
ln-liderazgo_conflicto_conversacion_nonv:
Act as a certified practitioner in Nonviolent Communication (Rosenberg method). I am going to give you a complaint formulated accusatorially or with emotional charge and I need you to reframe it. Deliver: (1) analysis of what each of the four NVC components violates in the original message, (2) the reframed NVC version in 2–4 sentences ready to use, and (3) three tips on tone and body language to deliver it in person or in writing. If you do not receive the complaint, assume: a leader telling their collaborator "You are always late to meetings and that shows you do not care about the team" — declare that assumption and proceed.

Protocolo MetodologIA: transform accusatory complaints into four-component nonviolent communication ready to use.
ln-liderazgo_conflicto_acuerdos_trabajo:
Act as an organizational development consultant specializing in team culture. I need to create a set of working agreements with my team to prevent future conflicts. Generate: (1) facilitating questions grouped by thematic area (communication, decisions, feedback, meetings, conflicts) for a 60–90 minute co-construction session, (2) proposed baseline agreements per area as a starting point, and (3) final document template ready for the team to adopt and sign. Each agreement must be observable and verifiable. If I do not specify the type of team, assume a software development team, declare that assumption, and continue.

Protocolo MetodologIA: co-construction of observable behavioral agreements to prevent conflicts with an integrated review mechanism.
ln-liderazgo_conflicto_silos_entre_areas:
Act as a senior consultant in organizational design specializing in team integration. I have chronic friction between two areas of the organization and I need a 4-week intervention plan to resolve it. Design: root cause diagnosis, initial alignment activities (including a joint dependency-mapping session), permanent coordination mechanisms, and 3–5 success metrics at month 1 and month 3. Include how to manage team resistance. If I do not describe the areas, assume friction between Development and Operations, declare that assumption, and continue. The plan must be executable with internal resources.

Protocolo MetodologIA: systemic 4-week intervention with root causes, permanent mechanisms, and success metrics to reduce silos.
ln-liderazgo_conflicto_personalidad_difi:
Act as an executive coach specializing in managing people with difficult behavior. I have a team member whose conduct is creating persistent friction on the team. Deliver: (1) diagnosis of the behavioral pattern with possible root causes, (2) direct conversation structure with key phrases I can use this week, (3) a 30-day support plan with verifiable behavioral milestones in a table, and (4) three decision points with clear criteria for escalating to HR. If I do not describe the behavior, assume a team member who responds with hostility to feedback and undermines team decisions in private, declare that assumption and proceed.

Protocolo MetodologIA: behavioral diagnosis, structured direct conversation, and 30-day plan with escalation decision points.
ln-liderazgo_conflicto_post_incidente_bl:
Act as an expert facilitator in blameless culture and engineering post-mortems. I need the complete structure to facilitate a 60–90-minute blameless post-incident conversation. Design: the opening with a blameless psychological contract, the factual chronological reconstruction section, root cause analysis with an adapted 5 Whys, the actions section with owner and date, the recognition close, the final document template, and the weekly follow-up mechanism. Include participation rules (maximum 5) and facilitating questions per section. If I do not describe the incident, assume a production service outage lasting less than 4 hours, declare that assumption and continue.

Protocolo MetodologIA: blameless facilitation with factual reconstruction, root cause analysis, and actions with owner and date.
ln-liderazgo_conflicto_disenso_productiv:
Act as a specialist in facilitating high-quality group decisions and preventing groupthink. My team tends toward easy consensus and people do not express objections. Design a set of practices for the team to learn to dissent productively: include 4 concrete techniques for decision meetings (devil's advocate, pre-mortem, and others), rotating roles that institutionalize questioning, 10 questions that invite dissent without creating conflict, and 3 dissent health metrics. If the leader is part of the problem, include how they can model dissent themselves. Assume a product or technology team of 6–10 people if I do not specify.

Protocolo MetodologIA: institutional practices of productive dissent with rotating roles, meeting techniques, and decision health metrics.
ln-liderazgo_cultura_definir_valores:
Act as an organizational culture design consultant specializing in behavioral values. I have my team's values declared in abstract form and need to convert them into concrete behavioral commitments that anyone can observe and verify. For each value, generate: a one-sentence definition, 3–5 specific behaviors in the first-person plural, and the opposite behavior that marks the boundary. Also design a 45-minute micro-session to validate the behaviors with the team. If I do not paste my values, assume excellence, collaboration, and innovation, declare that assumption and proceed.

Protocolo MetodologIA: conversion of abstract values into observable behavioral commitments with a behavior table and validation process.
ln-liderazgo_cultura_seguridad_psicologi:
Act as a team psychological safety specialist using Amy Edmondson's model. I need to diagnose my team's level of psychological safety and a 60-day plan to elevate it. Deliver: diagnosis with estimated level and evidence in observable behaviors, root causes of the current level, 60-day calendar with concrete weekly practice and associated metric, and 5 questions to individually diagnose each member. If the leader is part of the problem (including myself), the plan starts with changes to my own behavior. If I do not describe my team, assume a 6–8-person engineering team with silence around errors, declare that assumption and continue.

Protocolo MetodologIA: diagnosis with behavioral evidence, three intervention levers, and 60-day calendar with psychological safety metrics.
ln-liderazgo_cultura_team_charter:
Act as a high-performance team development consultant. I need to build a team charter for a team that is starting out or experiencing a moment of significant change. Generate the complete document with all sections developed (purpose, mission, behavioral values, norms, decision-making, communication, meetings, metrics, mutual commitments), the facilitating questions per section to co-construct it with the team in a 2–3-hour session, and the agenda for that session. Include a semi-annual review clause and how to onboard new members. If I do not describe the team, assume a multidisciplinary digital product team at a growing technology company, declare that assumption and continue.

Protocolo MetodologIA: foundational team charter with purpose, behavioral norms, decision-making, and semi-annual review process.
ln-liderazgo_cultura_rituales_equipo:
Act as a senior organizational culture consultant. Given the team context and its values (paste them below), design 5 recurring rituals — with an evocative name, frequency, duration, facilitator, step-by-step mechanics, and an explicit link to the value they reinforce — for a hybrid team of 6–12 people. If no values are provided, infer 3 typical of high-performance teams and declare the assumption before continuing. Cover daily, weekly, and monthly frequencies; add 1 quarterly closing ritual. Include asynchronous versions for distributed teams. Deliver the card for each ritual followed by a summary table with key attributes, and close with a note on gradual implementation.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions → design rituals → link values → deliver actionable table.
ln-liderazgo_cultura_reconocimiento_sist:
Act as a senior employee experience and organizational recognition specialist. Design a peer recognition system for an organization of 20–200 people that operates primarily in Slack or Teams (state the assumption if not specified). ln-liderazgo_cultura_disfunciones_lencio:

ln-liderazgo_cultura_team_building_propo:

ln-liderazgo_cultura_etapas_tuckman:

ln-liderazgo_cultura_carta_motivadores:

ln-liderazgo_coaching_modelo_grow:

ln-liderazgo_coaching_preguntas_poderosa:

ln-liderazgo_coaching_plan_desarrollo_in:

ln-liderazgo_coaching_mapa_competencias:

Protocolo MetodologIA: define the role and paste the job description; if you have collaborator data, include it.
ln-liderazgo_coaching_mentoria_estructur:

ln-liderazgo_coaching_career_conversatio:

ln-liderazgo_coaching_promocion_a_manage:

ln-liderazgo_coaching_autoconciencia_lid:

ln-liderazgo_coaching_microlearning_equi:

ln-liderazgo_coaching_sucesion_rol:

ln-liderazgo_desempeno_calibracion_sesgo:

ln-liderazgo_reuniones_diseno_agenda: Act as an organizational effectiveness consultant specializing in high-performance meetings. ln-liderazgo_reuniones_facilitar_decisio: Act as a facilitator of organizational decision processes. ln-comunicacion_email_disculpa_corporati:

ln-comunicacion_email_no_breaker:

ln-comunicacion_email_recordatorio_pago:

ln-comunicacion_email_introduccion_doble:

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions about the profiles and the connection reason before drafting.
ln-comunicacion_email_solicitud_referido:

ln-comunicacion_email_reactivacion_clien:

ln-comunicacion_email_negociacion_propue:
