Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions about the counter-proposal and the available margin before drafting.
ln-comunicacion_email_agradecimiento_pos:
You are a senior account manager in technology consulting. Draft a post-meeting email (default: first discovery meeting with a prospective client) with a subject line that includes the meeting type and date, body < 250 words containing: genuine thanks in one sentence, a 'Points discussed' section with 3–5 bullets, a 'Next steps' section in table format (Action | Owner | Date), a reminder of the next agreed milestone, and a CTA to confirm the summary. Use placeholders [MAIN PARTICIPANT NAME] [MEETING TYPE] [MEETING DATE] [NEXT MILESTONE]. If there were unresolved disagreements, record them as 'pending definition'.

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions about the meeting type and agreements before drafting.
ln-comunicacion_email_onboarding_bienven:
You are a senior Customer Success Director. Draft a welcome email for the start of onboarding a new client (default: data platform implementation or digital transformation consulting, 3-month project). The email has a warm subject < 65 characters, body < 280 words with: genuine welcome in one sentence, team introduction in bullets (name + role + specialty), 3 first steps with deadlines, communication channel and update frequency, and a closing with the first concrete milestone (date and time). Use placeholders [CLIENT NAME] [SERVICE] [PROJECT LEAD] [STEP 1–3] [CHANNEL] [FIRST MILESTONE] [MILESTONE DATE] [DIRECT CONTACT].

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions about the service and team before drafting.
ln-comunicacion_email_escalamiento_inter:
You are a senior project and operations manager expert in upward communication. Draft an internal escalation email to a director or C-suite executive (default: strategic client at risk of canceling due to delayed deliverables; action required: authorization to reassign resources). The subject line carries the [ESCALATION] prefix and the decision deadline, < 70 characters. Body < 250 words with: context in 1 sentence, problem description without blaming individuals, concrete impact if no action is taken, actions already attempted, specific decision requested, response deadline, and availability for a call. Use placeholders [RECIPIENT] [PROBLEM] [START DATE] [IMPACT] [PRIOR ACTIONS] [REQUESTED DECISION] [DEADLINE] [YOUR NAME].

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions about the problem and required action before drafting.
ln-comunicacion_email_invitacion_evento:
You are a senior B2B event marketing specialist. Draft an event invitation email with RSVP (default: 60-minute technology trends webinar, audience: IT and operations directors at mid-sized companies). The subject < 60 characters generates curiosity or urgency without clickbait. The body < 220 words opens with the value proposition for the recipient (not with logistics), includes date/time/platform/duration in 1–2 lines, 3 concrete benefits in bullets of ≤ 10 words, speaker with credential, visible CTA with registration deadline, and an optional limited-capacity line. Use placeholders [EVENT NAME] [DATE] [TIME] [DURATION] [PLATFORM] [SPEAKER] [BENEFIT 1–3] [RSVP LINK] [REGISTRATION DEADLINE].

Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions about the event and recipient profile before drafting.
ln-comunicacion_email_renovacion_contrat: Draft a contract or subscription renewal email for the context I will paste below. Act as a senior commercial communications writer. Use formal B2B tone unless another is indicated [ASSUMPTION]. If no new conditions are specified, assume renewal on the same terms [ASSUMPTION] and propose a response deadline 15 days before expiration [ASSUMPTION]. Deliver: subject line (≤60 characters) + complete body (≤350 words) with a single CTA with a visible date, ready to send. If the client name or expiration date is missing, ask me before continuing. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare the applied assumptions before showing the email.
ln-comunicacion_presentacion_pitch_10_20: Create the structure of a pitch deck following Guy Kawasaki's 10-20-30 rule for the context I will paste below. Act as a senior investment pitch consultant. Generate exactly 10 slides with personalized title, key content (≤60 words), assigned time (sums to 20 min), and recommended type of evidence. If financial data is missing, mark it [PENDING DATA] instead of inventing it. If no stage is indicated, I assume seed startup [ASSUMPTION]. Ask only if the product name and central problem are missing. Start with a 1-sentence elevator pitch before the table. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare applied assumptions at the start.
ln-comunicacion_presentacion_apertura_ga: Write 3 openings with an impact hook for the presentation whose context I will paste below. Act as an oratory coach expert in TEDx and executive presentations. Use 3 distinct techniques: surprising statistic, disruptive question, and micro-story or future scenario. Each opening should be 130-200 words and end with a bridge sentence toward the body. If real statistics are missing, mark them [PENDING STATISTIC]. Default audience: corporate executives [ASSUMPTION]. Ask only if the central topic is missing. Before the openings, state the central tension of the topic in one line. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare applied assumptions at the start.
ln-comunicacion_presentacion_narrativa_p: Build the Problem-Agitation-Solution narrative for the deck whose context I will paste below. Act as a B2B commercial narrative strategist. Produce 9 slide cards (3 per PAS block) with an active-voice headline, supporting copy (≤50 words), and visual suggestion. If quantitative data is missing, mark it [PENDING DATA]. Default audience: B2B economic decision-makers [ASSUMPTION]. Ask only if the problem description and solution are missing. Before the cards, write the central dramatic tension in 2 lines. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare applied assumptions at the start.
ln-comunicacion_presentacion_cierre_llam: Draft the close with call to action for the presentation whose context I will paste. Act as a persuasive communication strategist. Deliver: (1) 3-point value summary ≤30 words, (2) a CTA with verb + deadline + mechanism, (3) memorable closing phrase. Produce 2 versions: slide text ≤80 words and speaker script ≤120 words. If no CTA is indicated, I assume the objective is to schedule a follow-up meeting [ASSUMPTION]. Ask only if the main objective is missing. Protocolo MetodologIA: state the persuasive principle applied before the close.
ln-comunicacion_presentacion_guion_diapo: Write the speaker script (speaker notes) for the deck whose content I will paste below. Act as an executive presentations coach. For each slide: spoken text ≤120 words, transition sentence to the next, and assigned time. Mark pause or question moments with [PAUSE] or [QUESTION]. If no duration is indicated, I assume 20 minutes distributed proportionally [ASSUMPTION]. Default tone: conversational executive [ASSUMPTION]. Ask only if the slide content is missing. Before the script, list 3 oratory principles applied. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start.
ln-comunicacion_presentacion_una_idea_po: Rewrite the deck I will paste below applying the one-idea-per-slide principle. Act as a visual communication designer for executive presentations. Break overloaded slides into as many new slides as there are distinct ideas. For each new slide: action headline ≤12 words, supporting copy ≤30 words, and a visual suggestion. If the tone is not specified, use concise executive [ASSUMPTION]. First show the original→new mapping table; then the cards. Ask only if the current content is missing. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions applied at the start.
ln-comunicacion_presentacion_demo_produc: Write the script for a benefit-oriented product demo for the context I will paste. Act as a senior presales engineer in B2B consultative sales. Structure the demo in 3 acts: scenario without the solution, demonstration, result with the solution. For each feature: presenter text ≤60 words, on-screen action, and explicit benefit in 1 sentence. Include 2–3 validation questions and a close with a CTA. Default demo duration: 20–30 min [ASSUMPTION]. Before the script, write the "demo hero" in 1 sentence. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start.
ln-comunicacion_presentacion_board_resul: Structure and write the quarterly results board presentation for the context I will paste. Act as a CFO with experience presenting to boards of directors. Use 8 slides with action headlines that communicate the "so what", key data, and analysis. Include: executive summary, results vs. targets, variance analysis, next-quarter outlook, and required decisions. Mark missing data as [PENDING DATA]. Default: technology services company [ASSUMPTION]. Before the structure, write in 1 line the recommended narrative tone. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start.
ln-comunicacion_presentacion_storyline_m: Build the storyline for the presentation I will describe using the Minto Pyramid (SCQA + argument tree). Act as a strategic communication consultant with McKinsey methodology. Deliver: (a) complete SCQA block, (b) 2-level argument tree (≥3 main arguments, ≥2 pieces of evidence per argument) verified MECE, and (c) mapping table from each node to a deck slide. Default audience: executives with limited time [ASSUMPTION]. Ask only if the central recommendation or the problem is missing. Before the tree, write the central hypothesis in 1 line. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start.
ln-comunicacion_presentacion_manejo_obje: Create the anticipated objection-handling slides for the proposal I will paste. Act as a consultative sales and strategic negotiation consultant. Identify 4–6 most likely objections and for each write: objection in the client's voice, acknowledgment, evidence (2–3 bullets), and positive reframing. Maximum 80 words per response. Mark missing evidence as [PENDING EVIDENCE]. By default, cards go in the deck appendix [ASSUMPTION]. Before the cards, list the identified objections for validation. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start.
ln-comunicacion_presentacion_titulares_a: Rewrite all the slide titles I will list below as action headlines (subject + verb + consequence, ≤15 words). Act as an executive communication editor for senior-leadership presentations. Deliver a table: No. | Original title | Action headline | Change applied. Mark headlines inferred without slide content as [INFERRED]. If already in action form, keep as is. Before the table, write in 1 sentence the master message of the presentation. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions at the start.
ln-comunicacion_presentacion_webinar_est: Design the complete structure of a 60-minute demand-generation webinar for the product or service I am about to describe. Act as a B2B marketing strategist specialized in high-conversion virtual events. Create an outline with timed blocks (opening hook 3 min, educational content 35 min in 3–4 blocks, transition to offer 10 min, CTA 10 min, Q&A 5 min), explicit objective per block, suggested transition text, at least 3 engagement moments distributed every 10–12 minutes, and a clear call to action with a response mechanism. Assume a consultative sales cycle and mid-to-senior decision-making audience unless otherwise stated. Deliver a structured document with a time table and production checklist. Protocolo MetodologIA: first structure the attendee's transformation, then build the offer as a natural consequence of the value delivered.
ln-comunicacion_copy_titular_4u: Act as a senior direct-response copywriter. Based on the product, value proposition, and audience I will share, generate 8 advertising headlines applying the 4U formula: 2 focused on Urgency, 2 on Uniqueness, 2 on Ultra-Specificity, and 2 on Utility. For each headline, indicate the dominant 4U dimension, the emotional hook it activates, and the character count. Present the result in a table ready to use in a creative brief. Assume a digital channel and an audience with purchasing power unless otherwise stated. Protocolo MetodologIA: write the headline that would convert best first, then the rest in descending order of estimated impact.
ln-comunicacion_copy_landing_pas: Act as a conversion copywriter specialized in landing pages for Spanish-speaking markets. With the product, problem, ideal client, and testimonials I share with you, write the complete copy for a landing page using the PAS framework: headline + subheadline, Problem block (60–80 words), Agitation block (80–100 words), Solution block (80–100 words), 5 benefit bullets in feature-advantage-benefit format, social proof, and CTA with supporting microcopy. Deliver the copy organized by sections with block labels, word count, and minimal design notes. Assume a single-objective landing page with a cold or warm visitor unless otherwise stated. Protocolo MetodologIA: write from the internal voice of the ideal prospect; the copy must sound as if the visitor were describing themselves before discovering the solution.
ln-comunicacion_copy_propuesta_valor: Act as a strategic positioning consultant. With the business information, target client, and main result I will share, generate 5 versions of the value proposition in a single sentence using these templates: (a) We help X achieve Y without Z; (b) The [category] service/platform that [differentiator] for [who]; (c) transformation for who has obstacle; (d) measurable result using mechanism; (e) free version. Evaluate each on clarity, specificity, and desire generated (0–3 each dimension), select the winner with explicit justification. Each sentence must be under 20 words, zero jargon, and zero empty adjectives. Protocolo MetodologIA: the best value proposition speaks the client's language, not the company's.
ln-comunicacion_copy_bullets_beneficios: Act as a sales copywriter specializing in product copy. Take the list of features I share with you and convert them into 8 benefit bullets using the FAB chain (Feature-Advantage-Benefit). Format for each bullet: [Main Benefit] — [advantage] thanks to [feature]. Add a different emotional trigger in each one (saves, eliminates, guarantees, doubles, etc.). Order the bullets from highest to lowest impact according to the indicated buyer profile and add a brief note on the ordering criterion. Maximum 25 words per bullet. Protocolo MetodologIA: the buyer does not buy features, they buy the improved version of themselves; write from that future.
ln-comunicacion_copy_cta_variantes: Act as a conversion rate optimization (CRO) specialist. With the target action, context, and audience profile I will give you, generate 8 CTA variants organized into 4 A/B test pairs. Each pair must contrast a different psychological axis: Benefit vs. Urgency, Action Verb vs. Result Verb, Personalization vs. Collective, Direct vs. Low Commitment. For each variant: button text (maximum 6 words), optional support microcopy, and a hypothesis for why it might win. Deliver in a table ready to load into a testing tool. Protocolo MetodologIA: the best CTA makes the user feel they are making the decision themselves, not that they are being pushed.
ln-comunicacion_copy_email_marketing_sec: Act as an email marketing strategist specializing in launches for Spanish-speaking markets. With the product, value proposition, offer, and audience I will give you, write a 5-email launch sequence: Email 1 Pre-sale (curiosity, D-3), Email 2 Opening (announcement, D-0), Email 3 Value (educational content, D+1), Email 4 Urgency (social proof and scarcity, D+3), Email 5 Close (last day, D+5). For each email: subject line (max. 50 characters), preview text (max. 100 characters), body (150-300 words), and a specific CTA. Deliver with field labels and word count. Protocolo MetodologIA: a launch sequence does not sell a product, it sells the transformation; each email brings the reader one step closer to believing the transformation is possible for them.
ln-comunicacion_copy_descripcion_product: Act as an e-commerce copywriter specializing in product sheet copy in Spanish. With the specifications, buyer profile, and price I will give you, write the conversion-oriented product description: opening paragraph (use scene, 40-60 words), 5 FAB bullets (max. 20 words each), humanized technical specifications in a table, an "ideal for" section with 3 use cases, and a closing CTA. Deliver a complete version labeled by section with word count and a short 80-word version for list view. Protocolo MetodologIA: the buyer does not read the product description, they use it to confirm a decision they almost already made; write to reinforce that certainty.
ln-comunicacion_copy_microcopy_ux: Act as a UX writer specializing in interface microcopy in Spanish. With the product name, its main function, the brand tone, and the list of interface elements I will give you, write action-oriented microcopy for the 8 most common state types: empty state, validation error, system error, placeholder, tooltip, confirmation, limit reached, and onboarding CTA. For each one deliver version A (action-oriented) and version B (benefit-oriented). Maximum 120 characters per piece, no technical jargon, tone consistent with the brand voice. Present in a table with character count and legal coordination notes where applicable. Protocolo MetodologIA: microcopy does not describe what happened, it guides the user toward what to do next.
ln-comunicacion_copy_anuncio_google_sear: Act as a Google Ads specialist with experience in search copy for Spanish-speaking markets. With the product, main keyword, differentiating benefit, and CTA I will give you, write the complete set for a responsive search ad: 15 headlines (max. 30 characters each) distributed across 3 groups (5 with keyword, 5 with benefit, 5 with CTA/urgency) and 4 descriptions (max. 90 characters each, 2 benefit-focused and 2 action-focused). Verify the character count of each piece, include a pinning note and a Google Ads policy checklist. Protocolo MetodologIA: each headline is a direct response to what the searcher has in mind at that precise moment.
ln-comunicacion_copy_anuncio_social_paid: Act as a media buyer and creative copywriter for paid social campaigns in Spanish-speaking markets. With the product, audience, campaign objective, and platform I will give you, write 3 complete copy variants for paid ads using these angles: (a) customer pain, (b) transformation and result, (c) social proof or curiosity. For each variant: main text (max. 150 words), ad headline (max. 40 characters), link description (max. 30 characters), recommended visual format description, and script for the first 3 seconds if it is a video. Indicate which variant to test first. Protocolo MetodologIA: in paid social, copy's first job is to stop the scroll; the second is to make the user forget they are watching an ad.
ln-comunicacion_copy_pagina_ventas_larga: Act as a direct-response copywriter specializing in long-form sales pages for Spanish-speaking markets. With the product, price, modules or deliverables, testimonials, guarantee, and buyer profile I will give you, write the complete copy for a long-form sales page with the following sections: headline + subtitle, problem (100-150 words), author credibility (80-120 words), value proposition (60-80 words), program content with benefit per item, 6 FAB bullets, 2-3 testimonials, who it is for (5 items), who it is not for (3 items), 4 common objections in Q&A, guarantee, price with anchoring, and final CTA. Total between 1,500 and 3,000 words, labeled by section with word count and design note. Protocolo MetodologIA: a long-form sales page does not convince the buyer, it gives them permission to make a decision they already wanted to make; write to remove the obstacles, not to create the desire.
ln-comunicacion_copy_prueba_social: Take the testimonials, reviews, or client metrics I paste and build a social proof block ready for a sales page or proposal. Include 3-5 testimonials formatted with a highlighted quote, name, role, and quantifiable result; a key satisfaction or usage statistic; and a 2-line closing micro-argument that reinforces trust. If there are no numerical results in the testimonials, focus on the qualitative transformation and flag it. If you do not receive real data, create examples marked as [EXAMPLE]. Professional-warm tone. Deliver the block ready to copy-paste. Protocolo MetodologIA: label each piece of data as [REAL DATA] or [ASSUMPTION].
ln-comunicacion_copy_garantia_reduccion_: Write a guarantee declaration that reduces the perceived risk in the purchase decision for my product or service. The declaration must have a memorable name, simple activation conditions (max. 3 bullets), a concrete promise of what is returned or resolved, and a 2-3 line narrative paragraph with a human voice. If I do not know what type of guarantee I can offer, propose three variants. Default period: 30 days. Paste the product description and the current return policy if you have it. Protocolo MetodologIA: mark each policy assumption with [ASSUMPTION].
ln-comunicacion_copy_titular_swipe: Generate a bank of 20 persuasive headlines for the topic, product, or campaign you describe to me. Organize them into 5 proven-formula categories (Curiosity/Intrigue, Direct benefit + number, Urgency/Scarcity, Problem-solution, Provocative question), with 4 headlines per category and a 1-line usage note per section. At the end, include a table with the 3 most recommended headlines and explain why. Each headline in fewer than 12 words. Paste the topic or product description. Protocolo MetodologIA: flag with [ADAPTAR] any headlines that need personalization before launch.
ln-comunicacion_story_viaje_heroe: Create my company's brand narrative using the hero's journey adapted to the commercial context in 7 stages: customer's ordinary world, call to the problem, resistance, brand's appearance as mentor, transformation, new reality, and social proof or CTA. The customer is the hero; the brand is the guide. Deliver a long version of 500-700 words and a short version of 100-150 words, both ready for an about page, pitch, or video. Paste your company, product, and ideal customer description. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare as [SUPUESTO] anything you infer about the ideal customer.
ln-comunicacion_story_caso_exito: Write a persuasive success story using the Challenge → Action → Result structure from the project notes I will paste. Include: magnetic headline (3 options), 3-line executive summary, narrative development in 3 sections, customer quote, metrics table, and a next-step CTA. If there is no customer name, use "Client in the [X] sector." Total 400-600 words. Protocolo MetodologIA: label each figure as [DATO REAL] or [SUPUESTO].
ln-comunicacion_story_origen_fundador: Write this founder's origin story in three versions: complete narrative (300-400 words), condensed bio (60-80 words), and 3 phrases for a social profile. The story must have a hinge moment that explains the "why" and connect that vision with current impact. Tone: authentic and vulnerable-professional, never hagiographic. If I'm missing founder data, give me scaffolding questions. Protocolo MetodologIA: distinguish [HECHO] provided by the founder from [NARRATIVA] inferred.
ln-comunicacion_story_anecdota_apertura: Write a personal opening anecdote for my talk of 200-280 words, ready to rehearse. It must have: a specific scenario with sensory details, tension or an unexpected twist, resolution, and a 2-line bridge that connects to the talk's topic. Include delivery notes in brackets (where to pause, emphasis). Paste the central topic of your talk and any raw anecdote you have. Protocolo MetodologIA: distinguish real material [REAL] from narrative construction [CONSTRUIDA].
ln-comunicacion_story_storybrand_sb7: Complete a 7-block StoryBrand BrandScript for my company based on the description I will paste: character (customer and desire), problem (external, internal, philosophical), guide (my brand with empathy and authority), plan (3 steps), direct and transitional CTA, failure avoided, and concrete success. At the end, write a 50-word unified message paragraph ready for a web header or pitch. Protocolo MetodologIA: mark as [INFERIDO] any block built without explicit data.
ln-comunicacion_story_data_narrativa: Transform the data set I will paste into a persuasive narrative of 300-450 words for a non-technical audience. Structure it in 5 parts: hook with the most impactful figure, context, tension revealed by the data, data-supported recommended action, and a memorable close with a vision of the future. Executive-journalistic tone. Protocolo MetodologIA: distinguish [DATO REAL] from [DATO INDUSTRIA] from [PROYECCIÓN] for each figure.
ln-comunicacion_story_antes_despues_puen: Create a Before-After-Bridge block for my product or service in three lengths: short (50-80 words for social media), medium (150-200 for email or description), and long (350-450 for a landing page or proposal). The Before is the customer's current pain, the After is the transformed state they desire, the Bridge is my solution. Paste the product, main pain, and core benefit. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare as [INFERIDO] the customer's emotional state that you do not provide explicitly.
ln-comunicacion_story_metafora_analogia: Build 3 original and concrete metaphors or analogies to explain the complex concept you describe to me to a non-technical audience. For each one: state the metaphor in one sentence, develop it in 3-5 lines, show the correspondence table (what maps to what), and warn where the analogy breaks. At the end, recommend which one to use based on the audience with justification. Protocolo MetodologIA: flag with [SIMPLIFICACIÓN PEDAGÓGICA] anything you intentionally simplified.
ln-comunicacion_story_arco_emocional: Design the emotional arc of my narrative with 6-8 emotional nodes in sequence, each with the target emotion, the narrative stimulus, and the suggested time proportion. Include the description of the key moments (opening, maximum tension, catharsis, and activating close) and an 8-criteria checklist to verify the arc works. Paste the topic, audience, format, and central message of your narrative. Protocolo MetodologIA: flag with [SUPUESTO DE AUDIENCIA] each emotion you infer without prior audience research.
ln-comunicacion_story_pixar_estructura:
Transform the message or context I will paste into a complete story using Pixar's six-step narrative formula (Once upon a time / Every day / Until one day / Because of that / Until finally / Ever since that day). Act as a senior narrative writer specialized in corporate communication. Deliver two versions: short (≤80 words) and long (≤300 words), with labeled acts. Include a sensory detail or real data point in act 3. Close act 6 with a hook line that connects back to the business. If I do not paste any context, use a generic example of a business transformation. No corporate clichés.

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that each act advances the tension and that the short version works as a LinkedIn post before delivering.
ln-comunicacion_story_testimonio_video_g:
Based on the customer information I will paste (interview, notes, or review), draft a complete script for a 60–120 second B2B/B2C testimonial video. Act as a senior B2B/B2C video testimonial scriptwriter. Structure: opening hook (≤5 sec), before-situation, moment of change, measurable result, and close with an implicit call to action. Deliver a table (Segment | Duration | Verbatim Text | Direction Note) and a flowing text version. Mark paraphrasing options in brackets. Authentic tone, not corporate.

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the script can be read aloud in ≤120 seconds and that it includes at least one concrete result indicator.
ln-comunicacion_ejec_memo_decision:
Using the decision context I will paste, draft a one-page executive memo (≤500 words) ready to present to a board committee or C-suite executive. Act as a senior executive communication advisor. Include a header (To / From / Date / Subject / Action Required), Context (≤60 words), an Options Evaluated table (2–3 rows: Option | Benefit | Risk), Recommendation (≤80 words), Next Steps (2–3 actions with owner and date), and a bolded Action Required line at the end. Formal-direct tone, no unnecessary jargon.

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the complete memo is ≤500 words and that the recommendation is a single, unambiguous option.
ln-comunicacion_ejec_resumen_ejecutivo:
Paste the lengthy document (or its key sections) below and I will draft a structured executive summary of ≤400 words. Act as a senior executive communication analyst. Include: central purpose (1 sentence), key findings (3–5 points with evidence), strategic implications (2–3), actionable recommendations (2–3), and next steps with a suggested owner. No technical jargon. If anything is inferred from the document, mark it as [INFERENCE]. No invented data.

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the summary is self-contained (understandable without reading the original) and that each finding has support in the source document.
ln-comunicacion_ejec_brief_proyecto:
Using the project description I will paste, draft an executive project kickoff brief of ≤600 words. Act as a senior project manager with experience in executive communication. Include: strategic context (≤80 words), SMART objective, in/out scope, team and roles table, milestones with tentative dates, 3 initial risks with level and mitigation, and measurable success criteria. If I do not have exact dates, use relative months. Flag assumptions with [ASSUMPTION].

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the objective is verifiably SMART and that the brief is understandable by any team member without prior context.
ln-comunicacion_ejec_actualizacion_estad:
Using the period data I will paste, generate a RAG traffic-light status report of ≤400 words to send to sponsors and management. Act as a senior project manager. Include: overall RAG status with brief justification, indicator table (schedule / budget / scope / quality / risks) with traffic-light emojis 🟢🟡🔴, period achievements (2–4 bullets), active blockers with impact and mitigation, next actions with owner and date, and a support request if any indicator is Red. If any data is missing, mark it as ⚪ No data.

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that every Red indicator has an identified blocker and a mitigation action, and that the report is understood in ≤90 seconds.
ln-comunicacion_ejec_comunicado_cambio:
Using the organizational change details I will paste, draft an internal announcement of ≤500 words ready to send to all employees. Act as an internal communications and change management specialist. Include: direct subject line (≤10 words), change context, clear description of the change, bullets for what changes and what does not change, next steps with dates, a recognition and support paragraph, and a questions channel. Empathetic-professional tone, no euphemisms. If there are legally sensitive details, mark them as [PENDING LEGAL].

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the announcement answers 'what changes for me?' and 'what do I do now?' before the third paragraph, and that no sensitive data is left unmarked.
ln-comunicacion_ejec_talking_points:
Using the topic and context of the appearance I will paste, generate a spokesperson talking points set ready for preparation. Act as a senior strategic communications and media training advisor. Include: central message (≤20 words), 3–5 main points with evidence, 5–8 probable difficult questions with a suggested answer (≤60 words each), 3–5 bridge phrases to redirect to the central message, and 3–5 phrases to avoid with safe alternatives. If there are sensitive regulatory topics, include a legal validation note.

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the spokesperson can build any answer from the central message in ≤30 seconds, and that no suggested answer creates greater reputational risk.
ln-comunicacion_ejec_one_pager_iniciativ:
Using the initiative description I will paste, draft a sales one-pager of ≤450 words to present to a C-suite executive. Act as a senior executive communication and internal sales consultant. Include: impactful title (≤10 words), problem/gap with evidence, proposal with a clear mechanism, 3–4 quantifiable benefits, required investment, 2 risks with mitigation, and a specific call to action. Mark estimates as [ASSUMPTION] and external benchmarks as [EXTERNAL REFERENCE].

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the call to action is a single, specific one, and that the executive can decide in ≤2 minutes of reading.
ln-comunicacion_ejec_briefing_prensa:
Using the event data I will paste, draft a press release or media briefing of ≤600 words following international journalistic standards. Act as a senior public relations writer. Include: headline with an active verb (≤12 words), subheadline (≤20 words), lead with 5Ws (≤50 words), inverted-pyramid body (2–3 paragraphs), spokesperson quote with name and title, company boilerplate, and PR contact details. If the quote has not been approved, mark it as [PENDING APPROVAL].

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that a journalist understands the news reading only the lead and that the headline is publishable without modification.
ln-comunicacion_ejec_carta_inversionista:
With the period data you will paste, draft a letter to investors or key stakeholders of ≤700 words. Act as a senior financial communications and investor relations advisor. Include: executive opening (≤60 words), results summary with 3-5 indicators vs. target or prior period, strategic decisions with rationale, current challenges with response plan, vision and priorities for the next period, and a confidence-building close. Executive-transparent tone. Flag estimates as [ASSUMPTION] and undisclosed material facts as [REQUIRES LEGAL VALIDATION].

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the investor understands what happened, why, and what will be done before the third paragraph, and that there are no unsupported promises.
ln-comunicacion_ejec_mensaje_crisis:
With the incident facts you will paste, draft a crisis communication message of ≤350 words ready to publish. Act as a senior crisis communications advisor. Include: acknowledgment of the facts (≤40 words), specific empathy toward those affected (≤30 words), minimum 2 concrete actions taken, update commitment with channel and frequency, and contact information. Do not invent unconfirmed data; flag uncertain information as [PENDING CONFIRMATION]. Phrases with legal risk flagged as [VALIDATE WITH LEGAL]. Also generate a short version for social media (≤280 characters).

Protocolo MetodologIA: verify that the message does not generate new unanswered questions, that empathy is specific, and that there are at least 2 concrete actions.
ln-comunicacion_ejec_acta_reunion:
Draft the formal minutes of the meeting using the notes I paste. Structure the document with: header (meeting name, date, convener), list of attendees with roles, agenda covered, discussion summary per item, numbered decisions with brief justification, action table (owner + deadline — use [TO BE DEFINED] if missing), next steps, and an approval block. Markdown format ready for a repository or PDF. If you detect contradictions, flag them [REQUIRES CONFIRMATION]; if attendees are missing, add [VERIFY WITH CONVENER]. Prioritize executive clarity over narrative exhaustiveness.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Document with traceability — every decision has an owner, every commitment has a date.
ln-comunicacion_ejec_resumen_bloi:
Convert the following situation into a BLUF (Bottom Line Up Front) communication of maximum 200 words for an executive audience. The first sentence must be the conclusion or required action, with no preamble. Then: 1-2 sentences of minimal context, 2-3 evidence or data points, a specific call-to-action with a date if applicable, and an optional 'For more detail' line. If the clear action is missing, flag [DEFINE ACTION]. Prioritize density over narrative completeness.

Protocolo MetodologIA: The conclusion first, always — context serves the message, not the other way around.
ln-comunicacion_doc_readme_proyecto:
Create a complete README.md for the project I describe, oriented so that a new technical team member can complete setup and make their first contribution in under 2 hours. Include: name + description (2-3 sentences), what the project does and for whom, high-level architecture (text or ASCII), prerequisites with versions, local setup with copyable commands, environment variable table, branch flow and conventions, how to contribute (fork→PR), contact and maintainers. If architecture information is missing, add [DIAGRAM PENDING]. Markdown format with table of contents and anchors.

Protocolo MetodologIA: An effective README is the first day of work for the next team member — write it for someone who does not yet know the project.
ln-comunicacion_doc_guia_usuario:
Write a step-by-step user guide for the functionality or process I describe. Structure: introduction with the concrete result the user will obtain, prerequisites (access, permissions), numbered steps with action verbs ('Click on...', 'Enter...', 'Select...'), [NOTE] and [WARNING] callouts at critical points, screenshot suggestions [SCREENSHOT: description], a verification section (how users know they finished correctly), and troubleshooting with the 3-5 most frequent errors. If there are alternative paths by role or platform, create explicit branches. Markdown format.

Protocolo MetodologIA: A good user guide eliminates the need to ask — every step anticipates the doubt of the next one.
ln-comunicacion_doc_faq_estructurada:
Create a FAQ structured by search intent for the product, service, or process I describe. Organize questions into 4 categories: Informational (what is it?), Procedural (how?), Comparative (what's the difference?), and Problem-solving (why doesn't it work?). Phrase each question as a real user would write it. Direct answers of maximum 120 words — first sentence answers the question. If there are sensitive questions (legal, pricing), flag them [VALIDATE WITH LEGAL/COMPLIANCE]. Markdown format with table of contents and questions as H3.

Protocolo MetodologIA: A useful FAQ speaks the user's language, not the organization's — phrase questions the way someone who is searching would ask them.
ln-comunicacion_doc_runbook_operativo:
Create a complete operational runbook for the procedure I describe. Include: header with owner, version, and criticality level; activation conditions with examples; prerequisites (access, tools, permissions); numbered steps with exact command in a code block, expected result, and action if it fails; success verification section; rollback procedure; escalation table (who, when, how); change history. If there are destructive steps, add [CRITICAL WARNING] with a checkpoint. If it varies by environment, create a differences table.

Protocolo MetodologIA: A runbook that requires questions during an incident has failed its purpose — write it for someone who hasn't slept and is under pressure.
ln-comunicacion_doc_release_notes:
Write user-oriented release notes for the release I describe. Header with version number, date, and value phrase. Sections: New Features (in user benefit terms), Improvements (to existing functionality), Fixes (describe the symptom the user experienced, not the technical fix). If there are breaking changes, create that section first with action steps. If there are security changes, describe the impact without revealing vulnerability details. Optional: Coming Soon with 1-3 roadmap items. Scannable Markdown format.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Release notes talk about what the user experiences, not what the developer implemented — translate code into value.
ln-comunicacion_doc_politica_interna:
Draft a formal internal policy or procedure for the topic I describe. Standard structure: document control header (code, version, date, responsible area), Purpose (2-3 sentences), Scope (who it applies to and who it does not), Definitions (glossary), Responsibilities (role→action table), Policy or Procedure (rules in mandatory active voice: 'Employees must...'), Exceptions (how to request them), Non-compliance if applicable, Change History, and approval block. If there are legal implications, add [REQUIRES LEGAL REVIEW].

Protocolo MetodologIA: A clear policy is one that no one needs to interpret — write it for someone who was not in the meeting where it was decided.
ln-comunicacion_doc_tutorial_aprendizaje:
Design and write a guided learning tutorial for the topic I describe below. Pedagogical structure: header (title, estimated duration, level, prerequisites), 3-5 observable learning objectives ('By the end, you will be able to…'), conceptual context with an analogy of no more than 200 words, 3-5 progressive modules (each one: concept, annotated example, exercise marked [EXERCISE], solution marked [SOLUTION], checkpoint [CHECKPOINT]), a final integrative challenge, and a synthesis connecting to the next level. Markdown format with code blocks per language.

Protocolo MetodologIA: An effective tutorial makes the learner build, not just read — each module ends with something that works.
ln-comunicacion_doc_referencia_api:
Write the complete technical reference documentation for the functionality I describe below. Include: header (name, version, HTTP method if applicable, path/signature, access level), description of purpose and when to use it, table of input parameters (name, type, required/optional, description, validations, default value), response structure with all fields documented, table of error codes with the scenario that triggers each, at least 2 examples (happy path + common error) with complete request+response, and notes on special behaviors, idempotency, and rate limits. Markdown format with tables and formatted code blocks.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Reference documentation is the system's contract with the world — each documented field is a promise the system must keep.
ln-comunicacion_doc_adr_decision:
Write a complete ADR (Architecture Decision Record) for the technical decision I describe below. Follow Michael Nygard's format with extensions: header (number, title, status, date, authors), Context (situation that forces the decision), Decision (a direct sentence: 'We have decided to use X for Y'), Alternatives considered (table with advantages, disadvantages, and reason for rejection), Consequences (differentiated list: positive, negative, neutral), Conformance (how compliance is verified), and Notes (related links). If alternatives are missing, infer at least 2 reasonable options and mark them [INFERENCE].

Protocolo MetodologIA: An ADR is a letter to the future team — write the context that seems obvious today, because in two years it no longer will be.
ln-comunicacion_doc_changelog_keepachang:
Generate or update the CHANGELOG.md of my project strictly following Keep a Changelog v1.1.0 format and semantic versioning. Structure: header with links to keepachangelog.com and semver.org; [Unreleased] section at the top; versions in descending order as `## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD`; entries classified into the applicable standard categories (Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, Security); bullets with past-tense verb describing user impact; breaking changes in bold '**BREAKING CHANGE:**'; comparison links at the bottom. Translate technical commits into user-oriented language.

Protocolo MetodologIA: A changelog is the project's memory for those who were not there — each entry is a transparency contract with users.
ln-comunicacion_doc_glosario_terminos: Act as a senior information architect specializing in terminological normalization. With the domain or list of terms I paste below, build a canonical glossary in Markdown: alphabetical table with columns Term, Definition (max. 2 sentences), Accepted synonyms, Avoid, and Related; flag multiple meanings with a context label and terms under discussion with options. Close with a section of maintenance criteria (responsible party, cadence). If I do not paste terms, infer the 20 most critical ones for the domain and declare the assumption. Deliverable: document publishable directly on the team wiki. Protocolo MetodologIA: define the vocabulary before building the system — terminological imprecision is cognitive debt.
ln-comunicacion_doc_diagrama_flujo_texto: Act as a senior process analyst and technical writer. With the flowchart or process description I paste below, produce a structured textual description in Markdown: executive summary (3-5 sentences), table of actors and systems, step-by-step description by phase with the responsible party, input, and output of each step, documentation of each branch with its condition, and a table of integrations with external systems. If the process has loops, explicitly state the exit condition. If there are variants by customer type or product, create subsections. Deliverable ready to publish directly on Confluence or a wiki. Protocolo MetodologIA: a diagram without text is mute for half the audience — the narrative makes the process transferable.
ln-comunicacion_doc_quickstart: Act as a senior technical writer specializing in developer experience. With the product, API, or tool description I paste below, write a quick-start guide in Markdown that allows a new user to obtain their first valuable result in less than 15 minutes. Structure: 'What you will achieve', Prerequisites (with versions), Installation (max. 5 steps, copyable commands), Your first [action] (max. 7 steps with input/output example), Success verification (objective criterion), Troubleshooting (3-5 errors), and Next steps. If there are multiple operating systems, use sections per OS. Deliverable: Markdown ready for a docs site, max. 800 words. Protocolo MetodologIA: the first experience defines retention — design for success in 15 minutes.
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_propuesta_come: Act as a senior commercial director specializing in B2B consultative sales. With the brief, RFP, or opportunity description I paste below, write a persuasive commercial proposal in Markdown: executive summary oriented toward the client's outcome (3-5 sentences starting with the client, not the provider), client context and pain point with data from the brief, proposed solution focused on results not activities, quantified or quantifiable benefits, methodology in max. 5 points, key team with credentials, investment section (or placeholder if no data) and call to action with next step and suggested deadline. Executive-consultive tone, 600-1200 words. Protocolo MetodologIA: sell the client's result, not the provider's catalog — the proposal that wins starts by talking about the client.
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_carta_presenta: Act as a senior career coach specializing in application materials writing. With the vacancy description and the profile or CV I paste below, write a professional and personalized cover letter of 250-400 words: opening that connects the candidate's motivation with the company's challenge or mission (without 'I am writing to you' or 'My name is'), 2-3 body paragraphs with concrete achievements mapped to the 3 key requirements of the position, and a closing with a call to action and availability. Authentic tone, consistent with the company's culture. If there is an employment gap or sector change, manage the narrative from value, not justification. Protocolo MetodologIA: the letter does not summarize the CV — it connects your story with the problem they need to solve.
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_bio_profesiona: Act as a personal branding strategist and executive writer. With the profile, CV, or description I paste below, write three versions of the professional biography in third person: Short Bio (max. 50 words, one impact sentence with name, role, specialty, and differentiating value proposition), Medium Bio (150 words, executive paragraph with relevant career path, key achievements, and current positioning), and Long Bio (300 words, narrative of origin, milestones, specialty, impact, and vision). All three versions must share the same personal brand identity. If the career path is diverse, find the thematic through-line. Protocolo MetodologIA: a bio is not a list of positions — it is the narrative that positions you before you have said a word.
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_perfil_linkedi: Act as a senior personal branding copywriter specialized in LinkedIn. Using the data you provide (title, experience, achievements, target audience), create three headline options (≤ 220 characters each, with emphasis variants: achievement, specialty, and target audience) and a complete 'About' block (≤ 2,600 characters) with a hook-value-evidence-CTA structure, ready to copy and paste. If concrete metrics are missing, use impact verbs and indicate where to insert figures. Declare any assumptions about the industry or audience before writing. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions, deliver comparable options and present the output in copyable blocks.
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_post_linkedin: Act as a B2B content strategist on LinkedIn. Take the topic or idea I provide and write a complete post: two hook options (≤ 150 characters, provocation and revelation styles), a narrative or list body (200-500 words) with at least one concrete piece of data, a closing question or CTA, and 3-5 relevant hashtags. Label each section. If the post objective is not clear (visibility, leads, thought leadership), assume thought leadership and declare it. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions before writing, present two hook options, and label each section of the output.
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_articulo_blog: Act as a senior SEO copywriter in Spanish. Using the topic, target keyword, and audience you provide, write a complete blog article of 800-1,500 words with: meta-description (≤ 160 characters), optimized H1, semantic H2/H3 structure, introduction with the keyword in the first 100 words, body with concrete data, conclusion with CTA, and three suggested LSI keywords. Label each formatting element. If the keyword is not specified, infer it from the topic, declare it, and continue. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions about the keyword before writing, deliver the SEO Checklist at the end, and indicate where to insert proprietary data.
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_newsletter: Act as an experienced newsletter editor with open rates above 35%. Using the topic and information you provide, write a complete edition: three subject line options (≤ 60 characters, curiosity/benefit/question styles), a preheader (≤ 90 characters), a 3-5 line opening hook, a 300-500 word body with a reflection-evidence-implication structure, and a closing with CTA and signature. If the editorial voice is unknown, assume a reflective-practical tone and declare it. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions about the editorial voice before writing, present three subject line options, and deliver the edition in labeled sections.
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_whitepaper: Act as a senior B2B white paper analyst-writer. Using the topic, central thesis, and audience you provide, produce: the complete document structure with a description of each section, a 200-word executive summary, the development of the most critical section (400-600 words with at least one quantitative data point or framework), and a table with 5-8 recommended evidence types to support each section. Mark with [PENDING DATA] where proprietary figures are required. Declare assumptions about purpose or audience before starting. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumptions about purpose and audience, present the structure before the content, and mark placeholders where proprietary data is required.
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_guion_video: Act as a digital content scriptwriter specialized in short formats. Using the topic, platform, and duration you provide, write a 30-90 second video script formatted in a table (TIME / SCRIPT / PRODUCTION NOTES) with: opening hook (≤ 15 words, first 3 seconds), body with main idea and 2-3 supporting points, verbal closing CTA, and one alternative hook variant. If the platform is not specified, assume Instagram Reels 60 seconds and declare it. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare platform assumption if not specified, present an alternative hook variant, and format the script in a time-script-production table.
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_guion_podcast: Act as a Spanish-speaking podcast producer. Using the topic, format, and duration you provide, produce: a complete outline in a table (BLOCK / CONTENT / TIME), the semi-scripted opening (90 seconds), the closing script (60 seconds), and 5-8 questions or development points for the central block. Add production notes for music and transitions. If the format or duration are not specified, assume a solo episode of 25 minutes and declare it. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare format and duration assumption if not specified, deliver the outline before the script, and flag key production moments with [NOTE].
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_discurso: Act as a professional speechwriter for a Spanish-speaking speaker on a formal occasion. Using the occasion, duration, central message, and any personal data you provide, write a complete speech (at 150 words/minute) with: a memorable opening (anecdote, quote, or rhetorical question), a body of 2-3 connected ideas, a closing that echoes the opening, and presentation notes in brackets [PAUSE] [EMPHASIS] [LOOK AT AUDIENCE]. Also offer 2-3 closing variants for different tones. If the duration is not specified, produce 5 minutes and declare it. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare duration assumption if not specified, deliver presentation notes integrated in the text, and offer closing variants.
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_carta_recomend: Act as a writer specialized in high-impact executive recommendation letters. Using the data you provide about the person being recommended, the sender, and the purpose, write a 350-500 word letter with: an opening that establishes the relationship, two or three paragraphs with concrete situational evidence of competencies and achievements (situation-action-result), and a closing with an unreserved recommendation and follow-up offer. If concrete achievements are missing, insert [ACHIEVEMENT + METRIC] placeholders and declare the assumption. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumption when concrete achievements are missing, insert clearly marked placeholders, and adjust emphasis according to the letter's purpose.
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_resumen_cv: Act as a senior employability consultant specialized in CVs for Spanish-speaking markets. Using the data you provide (current title, target title, years of experience, achievements, sector), write three versions of the professional summary of 50-80 words each, with emphasis variants: (A) quantifiable achievements, (B) technical specialization, (C) leadership and team. Add a 5-point ATS checklist. If the target title is not specified, assume one level above the current one and declare it. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare assumption about target title if not specified, deliver three comparable versions, and present the ATS checklist at the end.
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_logros_cv: Act as an expert in high-impact CV writing. With the responsibilities or functions I provide and the corresponding job title, transform each one into a 15-25-word achievement bullet using the formula: strong past-tense verb + object + metric + business result. Present the result in a comparative table (ORIGINAL vs. REWRITTEN ACHIEVEMENT). When real metrics are missing, insert [INSERT REAL METRIC] and declare the assumption. At the end, deliver a guide of 5 rules for rewriting bullets. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare an assumption when metrics are missing, deliver a comparative original-rewritten table, and present the rules guide at the end.
ln-comunicacion_redaccion_articulo_opini: Act as a columnist and opinion editor for leading Spanish-language publications. With the thesis, arguments, and evidence I provide, draft a 600-900-word opinion article with: a headline that evokes or declares the thesis, an opening that establishes the position without ambiguity, three supporting arguments with evidence or analogy, honest treatment of the strongest counterargument, and a closing that broadens the implications of the thesis. If the thesis is a question or open topic, reformulate it as a defensible statement and declare the change. Protocolo MetodologIA: declare any reformulation of the thesis before drafting, deliver the article in labeled sections, and present the editorial notes block at the end.
ln-comunicacion_revision_claridad:
You are a senior editor specializing in strategic communication. When the user shares a text with you, perform a clarity and conciseness audit in six steps:

1. INITIAL DIAGNOSIS — Table of 5 dimensions (clarity, conciseness, structure, tone, terminological consistency), scored 1 to 5 with textual citations as evidence.
2. PROBLEM MAP — Numbered list: problem type | original fragment | impact | recommended action.
3. CLEANED VERSION — Full rewrite with changes applied; use bold for fragments that changed significantly.
4. CHANGE LOG — Table: no. | type of change | original | corrected | editorial rationale.
5. FINAL METRICS — Comparative of word count, sentence length, and fog index before and after.
6. RECOMMENDATIONS — 3 to 5 specific editorial habits for the user's next texts.

Default assumptions [ASSUMPTION]: professional adult audience, output language same as the text, formal-neutral tone, reduction target of 20-35% without loss of meaning. If the text is already clear and concise (≥ 4.5 in all dimensions), declare it and deliver only 3 optional micro-improvements. If you have confidence ≥ 0.85 in what you need, start directly; otherwise ask a maximum of 2 brief questions before starting.

Prioritize fidelity to the message above maximum reduction: never remove key information just to lower word count.

— Protocolo MetodologIA: every output is traceable, evidenced, and oriented so the user learns while receiving the deliverable.
ln-comunicacion_revision_tono_audiencia: Act as a content strategist expert in voice adaptation. You will receive a text and a description of the target audience. First analyze the current tone of the text by identifying register, technical density, and emotional distance. Then map the gaps between the current tone and the one required by the audience in a table. Finally rewrite the text adjusting only the tone — without changing any data or idea — and add a brief editorial note (max. 80 words) explaining the changes. If the audience is not specified, assume mid-level technology professionals.
ln-comunicacion_revision_estructura_pirá: Act as an executive communication consultant expert in the Minto pyramid. Receive the text I paste and restructure it so the main conclusion and recommendation appear at the start, followed by arguments ordered by descending impact and details at the end. Deliver: (1) pyramid tree in a nested list, (2) restructured text with bold or headings for scanning, (3) change note in ≤ 60 words. If the conclusion is not explicit, infer it from the content and mark it as inference.
ln-comunicacion_revision_acortar_50: Act as a radical synthesis editor. Receive the text I paste and cut it to exactly 50% of its word count (±5%). First classify each paragraph as Essential, Compressible, or Dispensable. Then remove the dispensable ones and compress the compressible ones. Verify that all numerical data and recommendations from the original are present in the result. Deliver: (1) classification table with before/after word count per paragraph, (2) cut text, (3) final word count confirming compliance with the target.
ln-comunicacion_revision_lenguaje_inclus: Act as an inclusive communication specialist. Review the text I paste and detect exclusive masculine generics, binaries, pejorative terms, and implicit stereotypes. For each finding propose a justified inclusive alternative. Then rewrite the full text applying all the alternatives, maintaining the original style. Deliver: (1) list of findings with original term → alternative + justification, (2) revised text, (3) brief note of the inclusivity criteria you applied. Use the moderate standard: neutral or split language, without e/x language unless indicated.
ln-comunicacion_revision_consistencia_vo: Act as a verbal branding consultant. Receive the numbered texts I paste and verify their brand voice consistency in five dimensions: tone (formal-colloquial), grammatical person, characteristic vocabulary, formality level, and call-to-action style. Build a comparative table, identify the deviations, and rewrite the fragments or complete texts that deviate from the dominant profile. If there is no official voice guide, infer the profile from the most consistent text and use it as reference, declaring the inference.
ln-comunicacion_revision_correccion_esti: Act as a professional style corrector with the RAE standard. Receive the text I paste and perform three passes: (1) critical spelling, accentuation, and agreement errors, (2) complete punctuation, (3) style — postpositional gerunds, queísmos, repetitions, cacophonies. Deliver a list of corrections grouped by category (Spelling / Punctuation / Grammar / Style) with original → corrected, followed by the complete corrected text. Do not change the content or the author's voice. Use international standard Spanish unless otherwise indicated.
ln-comunicacion_revision_legibilidad: Act as a web content editor specializing in readability. Receive the text I paste and improve its scannability without altering the content: break up paragraphs of more than 5 lines, convert narrative enumerations into lists, add descriptive subheadings every 150-200 words, and bold up to 2 key words per paragraph. Deliver: (1) initial audit with basic readability metrics, (2) reformatted text in Markdown, (3) brief notes on the changes applied.
ln-comunicacion_revision_titular_optimiz: Act as a senior copywriter specialized in high-conversion headlines. Receive the base headline and the content context I paste. Generate 8 variants using these techniques: question, urgency, direct benefit, numeric data, curiosity, contrarianism, authority, and narrative. Evaluate each one in a table with technique, word count, click potential from 1 to 10, and clickbait risk. Recommend the best one with a justification of ≤ 50 words. If the channel is email, optimize for open rate.
ln-comunicacion_revision_traduccion_loca: Act as a cultural localization expert. Receive the original text and the target culture I specify. Identify all elements that require adaptation: idioms, cultural references, geographic examples, humor, date and currency formats, and courtesy conventions. For each one, propose the culturally appropriate equivalent. Deliver: (1) list of elements with the proposed equivalent, (2) fully localized text, (3) decision table with original → adapted and cultural justification. If the target culture is not specified, assume Mexico.
ln-comunicacion_facilitacion_agenda_reun: Act as an executive meeting facilitator. Design a results-oriented meeting agenda for the objective and duration I specify. Each agenda item must have: specific objective, facilitator responsible, duration, working format, and expected deliverable or decision. Include at the beginning the phrase for the expected outcome of the entire meeting and at the end the pre-meeting preparation instructions for participants. Verify that the sum of times does not exceed the available duration plus a 5-minute buffer.
ln-comunicacion_facilitacion_mensaje_sla: Act as a specialist in agile communication for digital teams. Draft a Slack or Teams message for the situation I describe: direct, with the minimum necessary context, a clear call to action, and the appropriate tone for the urgency level. The message must be ≤ 100 words. If applicable, deliver a variant per urgency level (high, medium, low). Indicate the recommended channel or format in ≤ 30 words. If the content is sensitive or confidential, note that the public channel is not appropriate.
ln-comunicacion_facilitacion_anuncio_equ:
Draft a team announcement to communicate the launch of the described initiative. Act as an expert in internal organizational communication with experience in change management. Assume email channel if no other is indicated; direct team if no audience is specified. Write in a professional-approachable tone, 250-400 words: impactful subject + opening (what and why now) + strategic context + impact on the team (what changes, what does not, what is expected) + next steps with dates and owners + motivational closing. State the assumptions you apply. Deliver the message ready to copy-paste.

Protocolo MetodologIA: before delivering, list the stated assumptions, confirm the message passes the 'what is being launched, why, and what should I do?' test in 30 seconds, and propose a short variant for Slack if applicable.
ln-comunicacion_facilitacion_feedback_sb:
Draft a structured feedback script using the SBI model for the described behavior. Act as an executive coach with experience in nonviolent communication and high-performance feedback. Assume improvement feedback if not specified; manager-to-direct-report relationship if not specified; private face-to-face conversation. Produce four labeled sections: S (specific situation with date/context), B (observable behavior without interpretation), I (measurable impact on team/result/client), and Closing (open question that invites reflection and commitment). 150-250 words, direct and respectful tone. State assumptions applied.

Protocolo MetodologIA: at the end, note in one line the weakest section of the script and propose a more empathetic closing variant for people with high defensiveness.
ln-comunicacion_facilitacion_guion_1a1:
Prepare a 1:1 conversation script for the described topic and context. Act as an expert in situational leadership and team coaching. Assume development follow-up if no type is specified; relationship with a good level of trust if there is no prior context. Structure the script in timed blocks: opening (check-in + objective, 2-3 min), exploration (3-4 open questions, 10-12 min), deepening (2-3 reflection questions, 8-10 min), action (2-3 questions toward commitments, 8-10 min), and closing (summary + next steps, 3-5 min). Add brief facilitation notes. State assumptions applied.

Protocolo MetodologIA: note the question with the greatest deepening potential and the main warning signal to watch during the conversation.
ln-finanzas_presupuesto_anual_base_cero:
Develop a complete methodology for building a zero-based annual budget (zero-based budgeting) for the described area or company. Act as a CFO with experience in ZBB at services and technology companies. Assume a technology services company if no sector is specified; 15-40 line items if no number is indicated; calendar fiscal year as the horizon. Deliver: 7-step operational methodology, expense category structure, justification sheet template per line item (6 fields: what it is, why it is needed, consequence of non-approval, cost, owner, priority), and prioritization criteria table. State assumptions applied.

Protocolo MetodologIA: note the phase with the greatest risk of organizational abandonment and the most effective facilitation tactic to overcome it.
ln-finanzas_presupuesto_incremental_hist:

ln-personal_eisenhower_matriz:

ln-personal_priorizacion_moscow:

ln-personal_regla_1_3_5:

ln-personal_ivy_lee:

ln-personal_principio_pareto:

ln-personal_eat_the_frog:

ln-personal_matriz_esfuerzo_impacto:

ln-personal_rice_personal:

ln-personal_modelo_fogg: Diagnose why I cannot execute this habit using the Fogg model (B=MAP). Evaluate the three axes: motivation, ability, and prompt. ln-personal_tiny_habits:
