Protocolo MetodologIA: diagnose frictions → redesign physical and digital → prioritize → checklist for today.
ln-personal_recompensa_habito:
My habit is [HABIT] and I abandon it because I feel no immediate satisfaction when I complete it. What gives me natural pleasure is: [PLEASURABLE ACTIVITIES OR SENSATIONS]. Design 5 personalized immediate rewards (sensory, social, symbolic, playful, progress-based), evaluate them for ease and saturation risk, and create BJ Fogg's internal celebration script (micro-emotion + gesture + identity phrase). Include a rotation protocol to keep them from losing effect. If information is missing, assume morning exercise and state it.

Protocolo MetodologIA: analyze loop → design rewards → celebration script → anti-saturation rotation.
ln-personal_recuperar_habito_roto:
My habit of [HABIT] broke [DAYS/WEEKS] ago because of [CAUSE]. I feel guilty and don't know how to resume it. Give me: (1) a brief science-based self-compassion message, (2) the minimum emergency version for today (≤2 min), (3) a 3-phase recovery protocol: 24h emergency, 7-day restart, 30-day fortification, (4) a root-cause analysis with 5 whys and 2 systemic changes so it doesn't break again for the same reason. If information is missing, assume a daily exercise habit broken by work overload, state it, and continue.

Protocolo MetodologIA: self-compassion → minimum version today → 3 phases → root cause → systemic changes.
ln-personal_revision_habitos_mensual:
It's month-end and I want to do my habit review. My active habits are: [LIST OF HABITS with days done/days of the month, e.g.: exercise 18/30, reading 22/30, writing 8/30]. Relevant events of the month: [EVENTS]. Generate: (1) a visual adherence dashboard with a traffic light, (2) friction analysis for the habits with low adherence, (3) a recommendation for each habit (keep/adjust/pause/eliminate), (4) an assessment of whether I can add a new habit, (5) a commitments table for next month with concrete changes. If I have no data, use a qualitative estimate and state it.

Protocolo MetodologIA: measure adherence → traffic light → analyze friction → decide adjustments → document commitments.
ln-personal_zettelkasten_nota:
I want to turn this material into a permanent Zettelkasten note. The material is: [RAW TEXT OR IDEA]. The source is: [AUTHOR, BOOK/PODCAST/EXPERIENCE, YEAR]. This matters to me because: [OPTIONAL PERSONAL CONTEXT]. Generate the complete note in markdown with: a title as an autonomous statement or question, a body in the first person with the atomic idea in my own words, the source reference, 3-5 possible connections to other concepts, 2-3 questions the idea opens, and 3 indexing tags. If there are multiple ideas in the material, work with the most central one and list the others as candidates. State assumptions if information is missing.

Protocolo MetodologIA: extract atomic idea → autonomous title → first person → connections → questions → tags.
ln-personal_para_organizacion_archivos_d:
My digital system is a mess and I want to reorganize it using the PARA method. I work as [ROLE OR CONTEXT] and mainly use [PLATFORMS: Drive/Notion/local folder/etc.]. My active projects are: [TENTATIVE LIST]. Generate: (1) the PARA definition applied to my context, (2) a folder tree in markdown with a maximum of 3 levels, (3) 5 decision rules for classifying any new file in 30 seconds, (4) a 30-minute quarterly maintenance protocol. If I don't have clear projects yet, suggest the likely ones for my context. State assumptions if information is missing.

Protocolo MetodologIA: contextualize PARA → concrete tree → decision rules → quarterly maintenance.
ln-personal_notas_cornell:
I have these notes/transcript from [SOURCE TYPE: lecture/podcast/reading] about [TOPIC]. My learning goal is: [WHAT I WANT TO BE ABLE TO DO OR KNOW]. Turn them into a complete Cornell note in markdown with: a cleaned-up, hierarchical notes column (right side), a column of cue questions for each block (left side), a 3-5 line summary in the first person (bottom), and 5 study flashcards with front/back. [RAW NOTES HERE]. If information is missing, assume an intermediate-level lecture and state it.

Protocolo MetodologIA: clean → Cornell structure → cue questions → summary → flashcards.
ln-personal_notas_progresivas:
I want to apply Tiago Forte's progressive summarization method to this text. The purpose of my reading is: [WHAT I WANT TO USE THIS KNOWLEDGE FOR]. My level of familiarity with the topic: [NOVICE/INTERMEDIATE/EXPERT]. Process the text in 4 layers: (1) clean original, (2) key passages in bold (10-20%), (3) the most important fragments highlighted within the bold (5-10%), (4) an executive summary of 3-5 points in my own words. Include a guide on when to use each layer. If the text exceeds 800 words, process the densest block and let me know. [TEXT HERE]

Protocolo MetodologIA: check length → layers 1-4 → usage guide.
ln-personal_notas_literarias:
I want to turn these highlights/quotes from [BOOK/ARTICLE, AUTHOR, YEAR] into literature notes for my personal knowledge system. For each different idea, generate: (1) the idea in my own words (first person, without quoting verbatim), (2) the exact reference, (3) my genuine reaction or question about the idea, (4) 2-3 connections to other concepts. At the end, tell me which ones are candidates for a permanent Zettelkasten note. [QUOTES OR HIGHLIGHTS HERE] If there are several quotes about the same idea, group them. State assumptions if information is missing.

Protocolo MetodologIA: identify ideas → paraphrase → source → reaction → connections → candidates for permanent notes.
ln-personal_mapa_conocimiento:
I want to build a mind map of [TOPIC]. My purpose is [WHAT I NEED IT FOR: learn/present/write/decide]. My level of prior knowledge: [NOVICE/INTERMEDIATE/EXPERT]. Generate the map in hierarchical text markdown format with a central node, 5-8 main branches with 3-5 subnodes each, 3-5 cross-relationships between branches in a separate table, a rating of each branch by importance for my purpose, and a guide on what order to traverse the map. If the topic is very broad, propose a scoping. State assumptions if information is missing.

Protocolo MetodologIA: define center → branches → subnodes → cross-relationships → rate → usage guide.
ln-personal_outline_estructurado:
I have these scattered ideas/notes that I want to turn into a structured outline for [OUTPUT TYPE: article/presentation/proposal]. My audience is [AUDIENCE]. My main argument or thesis is [THESIS, if I have it]. Turn the input into a 3-level hierarchical outline with decimal numbering, where each section title is a proposition or statement (not a generic category). Diagnose logical gaps and propose the optimal order of presentation for my purpose. [IDEAS OR NOTES HERE] State assumptions if information is missing.

Protocolo MetodologIA: extract → thesis → propositional sections → number → diagnose → order.
ln-personal_segundo_cerebro_captura: Take the raw notes or fragments I paste below and apply the CODE flow to them (Capture → Organize → Distill → Express). For each entry: identify which stage it is in, assign it a PARA folder (Projects / Areas / Resources / Archive) inside Obsidian, write a distilled note of fewer than 150 words with the key ideas in bold, and suggest a concrete output (post, thread, memo, etc.) where you could express that knowledge. Return a Markdown table with the columns Entry | CODE Stage | PARA Folder | Distilled Note | Suggested Expression, followed by the notes in a copyable block. Assume Obsidian+PARA unless I indicate otherwise. Protocolo MetodologIA: apply CODE+PARA with progressive emphasis; deliver an actionable table ready to copy into the notes system.
ln-personal_indice_notas: Review the list of notes or folder structure I paste and create an entry index in Markdown for my notes system in Obsidian. Group by thematic area, write a one-line description per area, assign a status tag (active / reference / archive), and highlight up to 3 anchor notes per area to serve as an entry point. If I paste no content, generate a template for 5 generic areas. Return the Markdown document ready to copy as a home note. Protocolo MetodologIA: design the index as a living navigation map; prioritize accessibility over exhaustiveness.
ln-personal_glosario_personal: Take the terms or the text fragment I paste and build my personal glossary in Markdown. For each concept: write the definition in my voice (<80 words), indicate the context or domain where I use it, give a concrete example of application in a real project, and link related terms with [[term]] notation. Order alphabetically with a table of contents at the top. If the term has a standard definition, include it first and then my differentiated perspective. Protocolo MetodologIA: externalize tacit vocabulary into your own definitions; the glossary must sound like the user's voice, not a dictionary.
ln-personal_destilar_reunion: Take the raw notes from my meeting that I paste and distill them into a clean document with: an executive summary of 3-5 points, decisions made (with owner and date if they appear), next steps in action-owner-deadline format, questions that remained open, and a standout insight from the session. If there is no explicit owner, mark [UNASSIGNED]. Return it in Markdown, maximum 1 A4 page. Protocolo MetodologIA: distill without losing critical signal; every next step must have a verb+owner to be valid.
ln-personal_swipe_file: Take the fragments, phrases, or examples I paste and organize them into my personal swipe file in Markdown. Classify each entry by functional category (hooks, argument structures, striking data, opening phrases, calls to action, metaphors), write a context note per entry (source, when to use it, why it works), and assign cross-tags. Include a table of contents and a usage-instructions section. If I paste no content, generate a template with 2 examples per category. Protocolo MetodologIA: the swipe file must be a production tool, not a dead archive; every entry needs a note on when and how to use it.
ln-personal_deep_work_ritual: Design my personalized 10-20 minute deep work ritual to enter a state of maximum concentration. Include: an ordered sequence of steps (from scatter to flow), exact physical and digital environment setup, a start signal and a closing signal for the block, a reduced version for days with little time, and simple metrics to assess the quality of the block when finished. Base the design on the best practices of Cal Newport and Andrew Huberman. If I indicate my type of work and available schedule, personalize it. Protocolo MetodologIA: design the ritual as a pre-decided protocol; eliminate all friction of entering the flow state.
ln-personal_eliminar_distracciones: I need a complete audit of my distraction sources and a plan to neutralize them. Describe my typical day, the apps I use, and the type of work that I paste below. Classify the sources into push/pull/environment/internal, score them by impact and frequency, design a specific neutralization protocol for each high-impact source, and organize everything into a 7-day plan from least to most effort. Assume macOS + iOS + Google Workspace + Slack if I do not specify. Protocolo MetodologIA: audit before intervening; propose changes from least to most friction; never remove essential work tools.
ln-personal_minimalismo_digital: I need to execute a complete digital decluttering of my environment on macOS + Gmail. Create a structured protocol covering the 5 layers: apps, files, email, browser, and subscriptions. For each layer: define the decision criterion (keep/archive/delete), generate a checklist of actions ordered from highest to lowest impact with estimated duration, and at the end propose a reproducible monthly maintenance system of ≤15 minutes weekly. Include a reusable template for the monthly reviews. Protocolo MetodologIA: clean one layer at a time; set criteria before acting; create a maintenance system or the accumulation returns.
ln-personal_modo_monje: Design my complete monk-mode day to dedicate it to deep work without interruptions. I need: a time structure with 90-min blocks + active breaks, an isolation protocol with copyable messages for email and Slack, a preparation checklist for the night before, a checklist to start and close the day, and a specific success criterion to declare the day successful. If I indicate the main task, adapt the structure. By default use 09:00-17:00 from a home office. Protocolo MetodologIA: the monk-mode day requires total preparation the night before; on the day itself no decisions are made, only execution.
ln-personal_entrenar_atencion: Design a 21-day plan to train my sustained attention capacity, which is degraded by intensive technology use. Include: a baseline assessment, a progression of daily exercises from least to most demanding (weeks 1-2-3), weekly tracking metrics, a recovery protocol for overload days, and observable signs of progress at the end of the plan. The training must fit in ≤30 minutes daily. Assume a starting sustained attention of 10-15 minutes if I do not indicate more. Protocolo MetodologIA: treat attention as a muscle; gradual progression with progressive overload; progress is measured, not assumed.
ln-personal_gestion_notificaciones: Design my complete notifications policy to regain control of my attention. I need: classification of my apps by urgency level, rules for which notifications I accept in each context (focus/work/rest/emergency), step-by-step technical configuration for macOS + iPhone + Slack + Gmail + WhatsApp, a message to communicate my response times to my contacts, and a quarterly review checklist. If I don't specify my apps, use that stack as a base. Protocolo MetodologIA: notifications should respond to your priorities, not those of whoever sends them; design the policy from your attention needs, not from external expectations.
ln-personal_ritual_arranque: Create my 5-10 minute focus-session startup ritual. Include: a fixed sequence of steps with duration per step, an intention question for each session, preparation of the work environment (physical and digital), a start activator that signals the beginning of real work, a quick 2-minute variant for short days and a micro-ritual for restarting after an interruption. Assume I work with Obsidian + email + office suite if I don't specify. Also return a copyable pocket card with the essential steps. Protocolo MetodologIA: the startup ritual is the entry door to the focus state; each step removes friction and signals to the brain that real work is beginning.
ln-personal_recuperar_foco:
Act as a cognitive productivity coach specialized in focus recovery. The user has just suffered an interruption while working on a high-concentration task. Based on the description of the interrupted task, the type of interruption and the time available to resume (paste below), design a refocusing protocol: a 2-3 minute transition ritual, a re-entry sequence of increasing complexity, a mental anchoring technique specific to the task, and a protection shield for the next 30-60 minutes. If any data is not available, assume complex cognitive work with 10 minutes available and declare it. Maximum 350 words, direct tone, numbered steps.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Declare assumptions → execute protocol → deliver actionable list.
ln-personal_estado_flow:
Act as a performance psychologist specialized in flow states. Based on the description of the type of work, the usual schedule, the available environment and the user's previous flow experiences (paste below), design a complete system of conditions and rituals to maximize the probability of reaching that state. Include: optimal environmental conditions, a 10-15 minute entry ritual, ideal session duration, signals to detect that flow has been reached or lost, recovery strategies and a checklist of at most 8 items. If information is missing, assume intellectual-creative work in a moderate office environment and declare it. Maximum 500 words.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Declare assumptions → design system → deliver verifiable checklist.
ln-personal_higiene_atencion:
Act as a specialist in cognitive neuroscience and attentional health. Based on the daily schedule, the main digital distractions, the moment of greatest attention drop and the user's current rest habits (paste below), design a daily attention hygiene plan. Include a morning ritual before opening devices, 3-4 distributed micro-recoveries, concrete digital limits, a nighttime disconnection ritual and two simple tracking indicators. If information is missing, assume a standard 8am-6pm workday with a currently low level of digital hygiene. Format: hourly table + additional sections. Maximum 500 words.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Map the attentional cycle → design plan → deliver verifiable table.
ln-personal_single_tasking:
Act as an expert in deep productivity and behavior design. Based on the description of the user's current workday, their sources of multitasking, the highest-value tasks they postpone and their level of control over their agenda (paste below), design a system to turn their multitasking habit into single-tasking with deep focus. Include: a diagnosis of the current pattern, classification of tasks by type, redesign of the workday into blocks, an interruption-management protocol, a 2-week adoption plan and 3 techniques to anchor to the single task. If information is missing, assume a knowledge worker with a mixed agenda and a smartphone always on. Maximum 550 words.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Diagnose pattern → redesign workday → deliver 2-week plan.
ln-personal_aprendizaje_feynman:
Act as a Socratic tutor expert in the Feynman technique. The user wants to learn or consolidate their understanding of the concept they will paste below. Apply the complete technique: explain the concept as if for a high-school student (no jargon), identify the 2-3 most frequent points of confusion, create an everyday analogy for each one, generate 5 active recall questions from least to most complex, and produce a single-sentence synthesis (max. 25 words). If the user pastes their own explanation, evaluate it as well. If information is missing, assume basic-intermediate knowledge and professional use. Maximum 500 words.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Explain simply → detect confusions → analogize → verify → synthesize.
ln-personal_repeticion_espaciada:
Act as an expert in learning sciences and spaced repetition. Based on the topic to memorize, the number of items, the daily time available, the target date if any and the user's preferred tool (paste below), design a 30-day spaced repetition plan. Include: a schedule with increasing intervals based on SM-2, the number of new and review items per day, binary graduation criteria, a weekly tracking system in a table and basic setup in the chosen tool. If information is missing, assume 30-50 items, a paper system and 15 minutes/day. Maximum 500 words.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Declare assumptions → schedule with SM-2 → deliver tracking table.
ln-personal_flashcards_activas:
Act as an instructional designer specialized in active recall and minimum information formulation. From the material the user will paste below, generate between 10 and 20 optimized flashcards: open questions with a single correct answer, one idea per card, no hints in the question. Classify each card as Recall (R), Comprehension (C) or Application (A). Format: front (F:) and back (D:) on separate lines, or Anki CSV if specified. If the material is not available, generate example cards on the named topic. Declare assumptions if data is missing. Include a statistic of cards per level at the end.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Identify key ideas → formulate minimum questions → classify → export.
ln-personal_practica_deliberada:
Act as a performance coach specialized in Ericsson's deliberate practice model. Based on the skill the user wants to develop, their current level, their identified weaknesses and the time available for daily practice (paste below), design a 4-week plan. Include: a breakdown of the skill into 4-6 measurable sub-skills, a level diagnosis per sub-skill, identification of the zone of proximal development, 2-3 stretching exercises per weakness with an observable success criterion, a feedback system in 5 minutes/session and a weekly schedule. If information is missing, assume an intermediate level and 30 min/day. Maximum 600 words.

Protocolo MetodologIA: Break down → diagnose → design stretching → schedule.
ln-personal_plan_aprendizaje_30dias:
Act as an autonomous learning experience designer specialized in accelerated programs for adults. Based on the topic the user wants to learn, the target level by day 30, the daily time available, the purpose, and prior knowledge (paste below), design a 30-day learning plan. Include: plan scope, 4 weekly phases with specific topics, 2-3 resources per week, recommended active practice, a verifiable milestone at the end of each week, a pace-adjustment block, and the day-30 assessment. If information is missing, assume intermediate functional competence with 45 min/day. Maximum 600 words.

MetodologIA Protocol: Bound scope → structure weeks → define milestones → design final assessment.
ln-personal_interleaving:
Act as a learning sciences specialist expert in interleaved practice. The user is studying a topic with multiple subtopics using separate blocks (massed practice), which creates a false sense of mastery. Based on the topic, the available subtopics, the mastery level in each one, and the study time available per week (paste below), redesign the plan with interleaved practice: a subtopic-mixing sequence, a 2-week session-by-session calendar, active practice instructions, and an adjustment guide if the mastery level changes. If subtopics are missing, derive the most representative ones for the area. Maximum 550 words.

MetodologIA Protocol: Classify subtopics → design interleaving → schedule → deliver instructions.
ln-personal_curva_olvido:
Act as a memory and retention specialist based on Ebbinghaus's forgetting curve. The user learned new material and wants to fight forgetting with scheduled reviews. Based on the material or topic, the learning date, the number of items, and the time available per session (paste below), design: a review calendar with concrete dates at the validated intervals (24h, 72h, 1 week, 2 weeks, 1 month, 2 months), an active review session protocol (no rereading), management of forgotten items, and a tracking template. If information is missing, assume learning today, 15-20 items, and 15 min/session. Maximum 500 words.

MetodologIA Protocol: Schedule from the real date → define active protocol → deliver template.
ln-personal_notas_sintesis_libro:
Act as a knowledge synthesizer expert in distilling non-fiction books and PKM systems. Based on the book's title and author, the user's notes or highlights, the application context, and the questions they hoped to answer (paste below), generate a complete structured synthesis: central thesis in one sentence, hierarchical idea map, 7-10 actionable insights with a concrete application context, 3-5 specific action commitments, and a one-page reference card that replaces the book. If there are no notes, use the canonical content and mark [ASSUMPTION] where necessary. Maximum 700 words.

MetodologIA Protocol: Central thesis → map → insights → commitments → card.
ln-personal_aprender_haciendo: Act as a senior instructional designer in experiential learning. With the skill I describe below, create a 4-week 'learn by doing' plan: one practical mini-project per week with a tangible deliverable and a binary success criterion, plus a 10-minute reflection ritual at the end of each sprint. Assume beginner-intermediate level and 30 minutes available daily unless I indicate otherwise. Deliver a summary table (Week | Mini-project | Deliverable | Criterion | Resource) and an anti-procrastination tip. Target skill and context: [PASTE HERE]. MetodologIA Protocol: State the assumptions used at the start; apply the Do-Reflect-Adjust cycle in each sprint.
ln-personal_mapa_competencias: Act as a senior professional development coach. Based on the current role, the future goal, and the competences I share with you, build: (1) a competence map table (Competence | Current Level 1-5 | Desired Level 1-5 | Gap | Priority), (2) an analysis of the 3 most critical gaps with 2-3 concrete actions each, (3) a 90-day gap-closing plan with monthly milestones and a metric per competence. Assume the goal horizon = 12 months and prioritize impact on the future goal. Declare any inferred score as [ASSUMPTION]. Current role, future goal, and competences: [PASTE HERE]. MetodologIA Protocol: Back every score with observable behavior; do not score without an explicit criterion.
ln-personal_reflexion_aprendizaje:
Facilitate a learning reflection session with metacognitive anchoring for the experience or period you describe. Explore what worked and why, what you would do differently, and what personal pattern it reveals. Extract two concrete lessons in the first person, identify the metacognitive connection, and define an application experiment for the next seven days. If I do not indicate an experience, work on my most recent work week and declare it.

MetodologIA Protocol: state assumptions at the start, facilitate the analysis with the three questions, and close with a verifiable experiment in seven days.
ln-personal_revision_semanal_completa:
Conduct my complete weekly GTD review. Process the inbox you share with me, review projects and confirm that each one has a next action, identify waiting-for items, review next week's calendar, and define my three priorities and ten next actions by context. If I do not have a GTD system, adapt to four simplified lists and declare it. Work stage by stage and ask for confirmation when you need more data.

MetodologIA Protocol: state the system assumptions at the start, facilitate stage by stage, and close with the three priorities and ten next actions ordered.
ln-personal_retrospectiva_personal:
Act as an agile personal development coach. With the content of the period I share with you (notes, tasks, reflections), generate a complete personal retrospective: an executive summary of the period, achievements with evidence, obstacles and how they were faced, recurring patterns, energy and well-being level, and 3 to 5 SMART commitments with a review date. If the period is not specified, assume the previous month. If the input is less than 100 words, ask me 5 questions before continuing. Deliver everything in Markdown with a commitments table at the end.

MetodologIA Protocol: diagnosis → patterns → SMART commitments.
ln-personal_revision_mensual_objetivos: Act as a certified ICF personal executive coach. The user will paste their objectives from last month and a free note on how it went. If there are no written objectives, ask for them before continuing. Produce a report with: a status table for each objective (achieved/partial/not achieved), the root cause in one sentence for each gap, max. 3 actionable lessons, and an adjusted plan for the next month with at least 3 SMART commitments with dates. Close with a reflective question. Max. 600 words. No judgments about the person, only about the facts. MetodologIA Protocol: evidence before advice, root cause before solution, plan before closing.
ln-personal_balance_anual: Act as a life-design facilitator. If the user has no prior notes, ask them 5 annual-reflection questions and wait for their answers before continuing. With the inputs, create a two-part document: (1) Review of the year that closed with wins and learnings by life area, the pattern or theme of the year, and 3-5 growth insights. (2) Design of the new year with a one-sentence vision, 3-5 intentions per area and a unique, personal theme-word. Cover at least 5 areas of the wheel of life. Max. 800 words. No forced positivity. Protocolo MetodologIA: reflection before design, pattern before vision, intention before goal.
ln-personal_diario_reflexivo: Act as a psychologist specialized in therapeutic writing. The user will paste their note or free description of the day. If there is no description, ask for one before continuing. Write a reflective journal entry in the first person, 200-350 words, with these components without visible labels: precise naming of the dominant emotion, narration of the event, a meaning question answered, connection with a personal value, and a concrete action for tomorrow. Let it flow naturally. If the emotion is intense or negative, validate first. Protocolo MetodologIA: emotion before analysis, meaning before action, small before big.
ln-personal_after_action_review: Act as a high-performance coach specialized in debriefing. The user will describe an activity they have just completed. If they do not mention the original intention, ask for it in one question before continuing. Produce a personal After Action Review with 6 sections: original intention, what happened, gap and cause, keep (max. 3), stop (max. 3), start (max. 3), and a synthesis sentence of the core learning in 25 words or fewer. Professional and human tone, not punitive. If the result was very negative, start with the keeps. Protocolo MetodologIA: facts before judgments, cause before solution, keep before stop.
ln-personal_kpi_personales: Act as a data analyst specialized in personal measurement systems. The user will give you their goals or life areas they want to track. Produce a table of 5-8 personal KPIs with 5 columns: indicator, formula or measurement method, frequency, baseline (or how to obtain it) and 90-day target. If they have no historical data, use the first week as the baseline. If a goal is qualitative, convert it to a 1-10 scale with an anchor description. Max. 8 KPIs to avoid overload. Close with a 3-line implementation note. Protocolo MetodologIA: measurement before improvement, simplicity before precision, consistency before optimization.
ln-personal_revision_trimestral: Act as a consultant in the 12 Week Year system. The user will give you their current state and their objectives for the next 12 weeks. If they mention a previous quarter, start with a quick review (wins, gaps, one lesson). Then design the plan: define 1-3 objectives with their measure of success, divide into blocks of 4 weeks and detail 3-5 actions per week for the first 4 weeks. If the user proposes more than 3 objectives, help them reduce them. The final plan must be reviewable in 5 minutes every Sunday. Protocolo MetodologIA: focus before speed, week before year, action before intention.
ln-personal_journaling_gratitud: Act as a specialist in positive psychology and gratitude interventions. If the user provides context of their day, write the personalized entry; if not, create a template with brackets to fill in. Produce a gratitude journaling entry in flowing prose, 150-250 words, first person, without bullets or headers, with: a specific gratitude with its concrete why, an emotion named with precision, a micro-gratitude for something ordinary that is usually ignored, and a concrete intention to express or act from that gratitude today. Warm and authentic tone, without cheesiness. Protocolo MetodologIA: specificity before generality, emotion before reason, action before contemplation.
ln-personal_okr_personales: Act as an expert in personal OKRs. The user will give you their aspirations or draft objectives for the quarter. If they propose more than 3, help them prioritize. Transform their ideas into 1-3 inspiring objectives with 2-3 measurable key results each (in numbers or percentages). If they formulate key results as tasks, convert them to outcomes. Add a start action for this week per objective. Close with a 2-line note on how to do the weekly check-in. OKRs at 70% should represent an excellent quarter. Protocolo MetodologIA: outcome before task, measurable before vague, focus before coverage.
ln-personal_metas_smart: Act as a certified goals coach. The user will paste their wish or intention in free form. If SMART dimensions are missing and your confidence is below 85%, ask max. 3 questions; otherwise, declare assumptions and continue. Produce: an analysis of the wish's 5 SMART dimensions, the goal reformulated in a single sentence of max. 30 words that sounds motivating, the concrete first step that can be done within 24 hours in under 15 minutes, and the binary success criterion at the deadline. If the wish depends on third parties, reformulate it in what the user can control. Protocolo MetodologIA: clarity before commitment, control before dependency, small step before big plan.
ln-personal_rueda_vida: Act as an integral life coach. If the user has no scores, ask them 8 brief questions (one per area of the wheel of life) before continuing. With the scores, produce: a table of the 8 areas with a score and a one-line justification, a paragraph analyzing the imbalance pattern (max. 100 words), the priority area to intervene in first with its leverage-effect reason, and 3 concrete actions for this week in that area. If the user wants to improve everything at once, briefly explain the wheel effect. Protocolo MetodologIA: diagnosis before plan, pattern before symptom, leverage before everything.
ln-ia-automatizacion_diseno-system-promp: Act as a senior prompt engineer specialized in enterprise conversational agents. The user will describe the purpose of their agent, its audience and its constraints. If the use case is very generic, ask for the most frequent scenario before continuing. Produce a complete system prompt of 150-400 words ready for production (between triple backticks) with: a role declaration, the main objective, in-scope capabilities, out-of-scope capabilities, response style and at least 2-3 operational constraints. Add disclaimers automatically if the domain is regulated. Close with 3-5 bullets of design notes. Protocolo MetodologIA: role before constraint, scope before style, clarity before brevity.
ln-ia-automatizacion_system-prompt-perso: Act as a digital brand strategist and conversational persona designer. The user will paste the description of their brand, communication examples or fragments of their brand book.
